title.zh: 卷12 本紀十二 高宗本紀三
title.raw: 卷12 本紀十二 高宗本紀三

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月庚午，以額駙科爾沁親王色布騰巴勒珠爾貽誤軍機，褫爵禁錮。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, spring, first month, day gengwu: because the imperial son-in-law, Korcin Prince Sebten Balzhur, had bungled military affairs, his title was stripped and he was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Qianlong 21, on gengwu, Korcin prince and imperial son-in-law Sebten Balzhur lost his rank for military negligence and was confined.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀親王額琳沁多爾濟以疏縱阿睦爾撒納，處斬。

translations.literal: Khalkha Prince Erechin Dorji was sentenced to decapitation for laxly allowing Amursana to escape.
translations.idiomatic: Erechin Dorji, Khalkha prince, was executed for letting Amursana slip away.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以準噶爾故總台吉達什達瓦之妻率眾來降，封為車臣默爾根哈屯。

translations.literal: On day jimao, because the wife of the former Dzungar grand taiji Dashdawa led her people in surrender, she was enfeoffed as Princess Chen Merigen Khatun.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Dashdawa's widow, who led a Dzungar surrender, was made Princess Chen Merigen Khatun.

sentences.zh: 命尹繼善往浙江會審鄂樂舜。

translations.literal: Yin Jishan was ordered to go to Zhejiang to join in the joint trial of E Leshun.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jishan was sent to Zhejiang to help try E Leshun.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，阿巴噶斯得木齊哈丹等來降。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Abaghas Demuqi Hadan and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Abaghas Demuqi Hadan's party surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命哈達哈由阿勒泰進兵協剿。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Hadaha was ordered to advance troops from Altai to assist in the suppression campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Hadaha was told to march from Altai for the joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 原任副將軍薩喇勒由珠勒都斯來歸，命與鄂勒哲依同掌副將軍印。

translations.literal: Former Vice-General Sarala, having returned from Zhuoledusi, was ordered to share the vice-general's seal with Orenjei.
translations.idiomatic: Sarala, ex-vice-general, came back from Zhuoledusi and shared the vice-general seal with Orenjei.

sentences.zh: 命協辦大學士達勒党阿由珠勒都斯進兵協剿。

translations.literal: Associate Grand Secretary Daledang'a was ordered to advance troops from Zhuoledusi to assist in the suppression campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Daledang'a was sent from Zhuoledusi with troops for the joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，致仕協辦大學士阿克敦卒。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, retired Associate Grand Secretary Akedun died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Akedun, retired associate grand secretary, died.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，授巴里坤辦事大臣和起欽差大臣關防。

translations.literal: Second month, day guimao: the minister in charge of affairs at Barkol, Heqi, was granted the imperial commissioner seal.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, guimao, Heqi at Barkol received the imperial commissioner's seal.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以楊廷璋為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Yang Tingzhang was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yang Tingzhang became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上啟蹕謁孔林。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor set out on tour and paid rites at the Kong Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Hongli left the capital to worship at Confucius's forest tomb.

sentences.zh: 以策楞奏報獲阿睦爾撒納，命改謁泰陵。

translations.literal: Because Celeng reported the capture of Amursana, the Emperor was ordered to change course and pay rites at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng's report of Amursana's capture sent Hongli to Tailing instead.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor paid rites at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Hongli worshipped at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 免直隸、山東經過州縣錢糧十分之三，歉收地方免十分之五。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted three-tenths for prefectures and counties passed through in Zhili and Shandong; five-tenths where harvests were poor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili and Shandong counties on the route lost three-tenths of tax; poor-harvest districts lost half.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上幸山東，詣孔林。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor went to Shandong and visited the Kong Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Hongli went to Shandong and worshipped at the Kong Forest.

sentences.zh: 免山東海豐等三縣潮災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for tidal disaster in Haifeng and two other Shandong counties.
translations.idiomatic: Three Shandong tidal-flood counties were tax-exempt.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賑山東蘭山等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day renchen, flood relief was given for disaster in Lanshan and other Shandong prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Shandong flood districts including Lanshan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑浙江仁和等十五州縣場水災。

translations.literal: On day guihai, flood relief was given for seawall flooding in Renhe and fourteen other Zhejiang prefectures, counties, and salt fields.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, fifteen Zhejiang coastal flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲子，工部尚書衛哲治病免，以趙弘恩代之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Minister of Works Wei Zhe, ill, was relieved; Zhao Hongen replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, sick Wei Zhe left the Works ministry; Zhao Hongen took over.

sentences.zh: 策楞以誤傳獲阿睦爾撒納奏聞。

translations.literal: Celeng memorialized that Amursana had been captured—a false report.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng falsely reported Amursana's capture.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命薩喇勒以副將軍駐特訥格爾。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Sarala was ordered to station as vice-general at Tenager.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Sarala was posted as vice-general at Tenager.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，授碩色為湖廣總督，郭一裕為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Suose was made Huguang governor-general; Guo Yiyu Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Suose took Huguang; Guo Yiyu, Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳朔，上至曲阜，謁先師孔子廟。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day jisi: the Emperor reached Qufu and paid rites at the Temple of the First Teacher Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On the third-month new moon, Hongli worshipped at Confucius's temple in Qufu.

sentences.zh: 授清保為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Qingbao was made Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: Qingbao became Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 庚午，釋奠禮成。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the libation ceremony was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Confucian sacrifice ended.

sentences.zh: 謁孔林、少昊陵、元聖周公廟。

translations.literal: Rites were paid at the Kong Forest, Shaohao's tomb, and the Temple of the Primordial Sage Duke of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: He visited the Kong Forest, Shaohao's tomb, and the Duke of Zhou temple.

sentences.zh: 免曲阜丁丑年額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were remitted for Qufu in the dingchou year.
translations.idiomatic: Qufu's dingchou-year taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賑山東鄒縣等十七州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, flood relief was given for disaster in Zou county and sixteen other Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, seventeen Shandong flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，免江蘇宿遷被災河租，湖北潛江等五州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, canal rents were remitted for disaster in Suqian, Jiangsu; last year's flood quota taxes in Qianjiang and four other Hubei prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Jiangsu canal rents and five Hubei flood counties' last-year taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命哈達哈進兵烏梁海布延圖，以青滾雜卜、車布登為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Hadaha was ordered to advance on Uriankhai at Buyantu; Qinggunjab and Chebudeng were made campaign assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Hadaha marched on Buyantu; Qinggunjab and Chebudeng became expedition advisers.

sentences.zh: 策楞等奏復伊犁。

translations.literal: Celeng and others memorialized the recovery of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng reported Ili restored.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免安徽宿州等二十一州縣衛、江蘇阜寧等七十二州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, last year's flood quota taxes were remitted for twenty-one Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou, and seventy-two Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Funing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, ninety-three Anhui and Jiangsu flood districts lost last year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、景陵，詣孝賢皇后陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor paid rites at Zhaoxi Tomb, Xiaoling, and Jingling, and offered libation at Empress Xiaoxian's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hongli worshipped at the imperial tombs and poured wine for Empress Xiaoxian.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜鄂樂舜自盡。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, E Leshun was granted permission to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, E Leshun was ordered to commit suicide.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，免山東鄒縣等十九州縣衛上年潮災額賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi: last year's tidal-disaster quota taxes were remitted for Zou county and eighteen other Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, renzi, nineteen Shandong tidal-flood districts lost last year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 命達勒党阿由西路、哈達哈由北路進征哈薩克，以哈甯阿、鄂實為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Daledang'a was ordered to campaign against the Kazakhs by the western route; Hadaha by the northern route; Haning'a and Eshe were made campaign assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Daledang'a took the west, Hadaha the north, against the Kazakhs; Haning'a and Eshe advised.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命大學士傅恆赴額林哈畢爾噶整飭軍務。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Grand Secretary Fu Heng was ordered to go to Erjen Habirga to put military affairs in order.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Fu Heng was sent to Erjen Habirga to reform the front.

sentences.zh: 策楞、玉保逮問。

translations.literal: Celeng and Yubao were arrested and questioned.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng and Yubao were taken into custody.

sentences.zh: 以烏勒登疏縱阿睦爾撒納處斬。

translations.literal: Uleden was sentenced to decapitation for laxly allowing Amursana to escape.
translations.idiomatic: Uleden was executed for letting Amursana escape.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命尚書阿裏袞在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Minister Aligun was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Aligun joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，召傅恆回京。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Fu Heng was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Fu Heng was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 富德奏敗哈薩克于塞伯蘇台。

translations.literal: Fude memorialized defeating the Kazakhs at Saibosutai.
translations.idiomatic: Fude reported a Kazakh defeat at Saibosutai.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，免山西岢嵐州二十年霜災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renxu, twenty years of frost-disaster quota taxes were remitted for Kelan prefecture, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Kelan, Shanxi, shed twenty years of frost-disaster back taxes.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，軍機大臣雅爾哈善、劉綸罷。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Grand Councillors Yarhashan and Liu Lun were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Yarhashan and Liu Lun left the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 命裘曰修在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Qiu Yixiu was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Yixiu joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，召劉統勳回京。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Liu Tongxun was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Liu Tongxun was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰朔，玉保降領隊大臣，以達勒党阿為定邊右副將軍，巴祿為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day wuchen: Yubao was demoted to leading commander; Daledang'a was made Right Vice-General for Pacifying the Frontier; Balu campaign assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon, Yubao was demoted; Daledang'a became right frontier vice-general; Balu, adviser.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免浙江仁和等十三州縣上年被災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, last year's disaster quota taxes were remitted for Renhe and twelve other Zhejiang prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, thirteen Zhejiang disaster counties lost last year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Hongli prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以莽阿納、達什車淩為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Mangana and Dashiceling were made campaign assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Mangana and Dashiceling became expedition advisers.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免甘肅甘州等三府本年民屯額賦。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, this year's civilian-colony quota taxes were remitted for Ganzhou and two other Gansu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, three Gansu prefectures' settler taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅皋蘭等二十廳州縣上年霜雹災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for last year's hail and frost in Gaolan and nineteen other Gansu prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty Gansu districts received hail and frost relief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，噶勒雜特宰桑根敦等來降。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Galzut zaisang Genden and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Galzut chief Genden's party surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以莽阿納為歸化城都統。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Mangana was made commander at Guihua city.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Mangana took command at Guihua.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，何國宗降調，以趙弘恩為左都御史，調汪由敦為工部尚書，劉統勳為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guichou, He Guozong was demoted and transferred; Zhao Hongen was made Left Censor-in-Chief; Wang Youdun transferred to Minister of Works; Liu Tongxun Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, He Guozong was demoted; Zhao Hongen took the censorate; Wang Youdun, Works; Liu Tongxun, Punishments.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，伯什阿噶什屬宰桑賽音伯克來降。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the zaisang Sayinbeg of Boshigashi's following came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Sayinbeg, a Boshigashi subchief, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，杜爾伯特台吉伯什阿噶什遣使來降，命封親王。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Dorbet taiji Boshigashi sent envoys to surrender and was ordered enfeoffed as prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Boshigashi of the Dorbet sent envoys; he was made a prince.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，封杜爾伯特台吉烏巴什為貝子。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Dorbet taiji Ubashi was enfeoffed as beizi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Dorbet taiji Ubashi became a beizi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，免安徽無為等三十二州衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen: last year's flood quota taxes were remitted for Wuwei and thirty-one other Anhui prefectures and guards.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, wuchen, thirty-two Anhui flood districts lost last year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬申，特楞古特宰桑敦多克及古爾班和卓等於濟爾瑪台詐降，哈達哈等率兵殄之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Telingut zaisang Dundok and Gurban Khoja and others feigned surrender at Jier Matai; Hadaha and others led troops and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Dundok and Gurban Khoja feigned surrender at Jier Matai; Hadaha annihilated them.

sentences.zh: 授哈達哈領侍衛內大臣，車布登紮布郡王，唐喀祿、舒赫德副都統，三都布多爾濟公爵，餘議敘有差。

translations.literal: Hadaha was made chief chamberlain of the imperial bodyguard; Chebudeng Jab duke; Tangkalu and Suhede vice commandants; Sanduobudorji duke; the rest rewarded with graded honors.
translations.idiomatic: Hadaha became inner chamberlain; Chebudeng Jab, duke; Tangkalu and Suhede, vice commandants; others rewarded by rank.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，漕運總督瑚寶卒，以張師載代之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Grain Transport Governor-General Hubao died; Zhang Shizai replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Hubao died; Zhang Shizai took the canal post.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上幸清河，至班第、鄂容安喪次賜奠。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor went to Qinghe and bestowed offerings at the mourning lodges of Bandi and E Rong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Hongli mourned Bandi and E Rong'an at Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以青滾雜卜叛跡已著，諭舒明、成袞紮布等捕剿之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, because Qinggunjab's rebellious tracks were clear, an edict ordered Shuming, Chenggunjab, and others to capture and suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, with Qinggunjab's rebellion evident, Shuming and Chenggunjab were told to hunt him down.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，庫車伯克鄂對等來降。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Kucha beg Odui and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Odui of Kucha and others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，以綽爾多為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin: Chuo'erduo was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, renyin, Chuo'erduo became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命喀爾喀親王成袞紮布為定邊左副將軍，舒明、阿蘭泰、桑齋多爾濟、德沁紮布、塔勒瑪善為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Khalkha Prince Chenggunjab was made Left Vice-General for Pacifying the Frontier; Shuming, Alantai, Sangzhai Dorji, Deqinjab, and Talemaasan campaign assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Chenggunjab became left frontier vice-general; five others became expedition advisers.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命納木紮勒、德木楚克為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Namuzhale and Demuchuke were made campaign assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Namuzhale and Demuchuke became expedition advisers.

sentences.zh: 以保德署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Baode was ordered acting commander at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Baode acted as Suiyuan commander.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Hongli and the Empress Dowager left for the Mulan autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 磔阿巴噶斯等於市。

translations.literal: Abaghas and others were dismembered at the market.
translations.idiomatic: Abaghas and others were executed by lingchi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑車臣汗部落扎薩克輔國公成袞等六旗旱災。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, drought relief was given for six banners including Jaksaq Assistant State Duke Chenggun of the Tsetsen Khan tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, six Tsetsen Khan banners received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 額魯特達瑪琳來降。

translations.literal: The Oirat Damalin came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Oirat Damalin surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上奉皇太后巡幸木蘭，行圍。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, toured Mulan and held the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Hongli and the Empress Dowager hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 授瑚圖靈阿、富昌、保德、哲庫納、阿爾賓為參贊大臣，隨成袞紮布辦事。

translations.literal: Hutuling'a, Fuchang, Baode, Zhekuna, and Arbin were made campaign assistant commissioners to serve with Chenggunjab.
translations.idiomatic: Five men became advisers under Chenggunjab.

sentences.zh: 以保雲署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Baoyun was ordered acting commander at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyun acted as Suiyuan commander.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，台吉伯什阿噶什入覲，召見行殿，賜宴。

translations.literal: On day renxu, taiji Boshigashi entered audience; he was summoned to the traveling palace and granted a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Boshigashi was received at the traveling palace and feasted.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，予成袞紮布等議敘。

translations.literal: On day guihai, graded honors were granted to Chenggunjab and others.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Chenggunjab's party received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以喀爾喀貝勒品級車木楚克紮布接續台站，封為貝勒。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Khalkha beile-rank Chemuchukeb, for continuing relay stations, was enfeoffed as beile.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Chemuchukeb of Khalkha was made beile for maintaining relay stations.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，哈達哈等征哈薩克，大敗之。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Hadaha and others campaigned against the Kazakhs and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Hadaha routed the Kazakhs.

sentences.zh: 授紮拉豐阿為貝子，明瑞為副都統。

translations.literal: Zhalafenga was enfeoffed as beizi; Mingrui vice commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalafenga became beizi; Mingrui, vice commandant.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西長安等十三廳州縣雹災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for hail disaster in Chang'an and twelve other Shaanxi prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Shaanxi hail districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，達瓦齊近族台吉巴里率人戶來降，命附牧紮哈沁地方。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu: taiji Bari of Dawachi's close kin led households in surrender and was ordered to graze at Zahakin.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, jiaxu, Bari of Dawachi's kin surrendered and was settled at Zahakin.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，土爾扈特台吉敦多布達什遣使臣吹紮布入貢，上召見於行幄，賜宴。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Torgut taiji Dundobdash sent the envoy Chuizhab to pay tribute; the Emperor summoned him at the traveling tent and granted a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Dundobdash sent Chuizhab with tribute; Hongli feasted him at the traveling tent.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免甘肅乾隆元年至十五年積年欠賦，及寧夏安西等二十二州縣衛本年額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, accumulated tax arrears from Qianlong years 1 through 15 in Gansu were remitted, and this year's quota taxes in Ningxia, Anxi, and twenty other prefectures and guards were remitted by gradation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Gansu back taxes through year 15 were forgiven; twenty-two northwest districts got partial tax relief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上奉皇太后回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to lodge at the Mountain Resort for Escaping the Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Hongli and the Empress Dowager returned to the Summer Resort.

sentences.zh: 授杜爾伯特親王伯什阿噶什為盟長。

translations.literal: Dorbet Prince Boshigashi was made league chief.
translations.idiomatic: Boshigashi, Dorbet prince, became league chief.

sentences.zh: 乙未，暹羅國王遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the king of Siam sent envoys with tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 賑山東魚台等縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given for disaster in Yutai and other Shandong counties.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong flood counties including Yutai were relieved.

sentences.zh: 閏九月癸卯，封羅卜藏車楞之子塔木楚克紮布為貝勒。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, day guimao: Luobuzha Cheling's son Tamuchukeb was enfeoffed as beile.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary ninth-month guimao, Tamuchukeb son of Luobuzha Cheling became beile.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上奉皇太后回蹕。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned in triumph.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Hongli and the Empress Dowager returned from the tour.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，授阿桂為北路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Agui was made campaign assistant commissioner for the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Agui became northern-route adviser.

sentences.zh: 准借黑龍江被水人戶籽種口糧。

translations.literal: Permission was granted to lend seed grain and rations to flood-affected households in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang flood victims could borrow seed and rations.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Hongli and the Empress Dowager returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽宿州等十二州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was given for disaster in Suzhou and eleven other Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Anhui flood districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免江蘇清河十二州縣衛被災漕項。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, grain-transport levies were remitted for disaster in Qinghe and eleven other Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, twelve Jiangsu disaster districts lost canal levies.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，命哈達哈以參贊大臣隨同成袞紮布辦事，阿裏袞、富德回京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: Hadaha was ordered to serve as campaign assistant commissioner with Chenggunjab; Aligun and Fude recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuchen, Hadaha joined Chenggunjab; Aligun and Fude returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以富勒赫未能豫防河決，召來京。

translations.literal: On day renshen, because Fulehe had failed to prevent the river breach in advance, he was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Fulehe was recalled to Beijing for failing to prevent the breach.

sentences.zh: 命愛必達為河道總督，劉統勳署之。

translations.literal: Aibida was ordered Canal Governor-General; Liu Tongxun acted in the post.
translations.idiomatic: Aibida became canal commissioner; Liu Tongxun acted.

sentences.zh: 調鶴年為山東巡撫，授尹繼善兩江總督，兼管河務。

translations.literal: He Nian was transferred to Shandong governor; Yin Jishan was appointed Liangjiang governor-general and concurrently charged with canal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He Nian took Shandong; Yin Jishan became Liangjiang governor-general with canals.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以滿福為巴里坤都統。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Manfu was made Barkul garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Manfu became Barkul commander.

sentences.zh: 丙子，兆惠以回部霍集占叛狀聞，遣阿敏道等進兵。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zhaohui reported the rebellion of Khoja Jihan in the Muslim west and dispatched Amin Dao and others to advance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Zhaohui reported Khoja Jihan's revolt and sent Amin Dao forward.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，輝特台吉巴雅爾叛掠洪霍爾拜、紮哈沁，命寧夏將軍和起討之。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Khalkha taiji Bayar rebelled and raided Hong Huo'erbai and Zhahaqin; Ningxia general Heqi was ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, taiji Bayar raided the frontier; General Heqi of Ningxia was told to attack.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賑直隸延慶等八州縣衛本年水災雹災。

translations.literal: On day jimao, relief was given for this year's flood and hail in eight Zhili prefectures, counties, and guards including Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, eight Zhili districts including Yanqing received flood and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，致仕大學士福敏卒。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, retired Grand Secretary Fu Min died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, retired Grand Secretary Fu Min died.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，賑甘肅皋蘭等二十六廳州縣水雹災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingwei: relief was given for flood and hail in twenty-six Gansu prefectures, departments, and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei day, twenty-six Gansu districts including Gaolan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，調陳宏謀為陝西巡撫，圖勒炳阿為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Chen Hongmou was transferred to Shaanxi governor; Tulebing'a to Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Chen Hongmou took Shaanxi and Tulebing'a Hunan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命仍逮問策楞、玉保。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the order to continue arresting and questioning Celeng and Yubao was renewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Celeng and Yubao were again to be seized and tried.

sentences.zh: 降封紮拉豐阿公爵。

translations.literal: Zhala Feng'a was demoted from duke rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhala Feng'a was reduced from duke.

sentences.zh: 以達勒党阿為定西將軍，兆惠為定邊右副將軍，永貴為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Daledang'a was made Dingxi general, Zhaohui Right Deputy General for Pacifying the Frontier, and Yonggui campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Daledang'a became Dingxi general; Zhaohui western deputy commander; Yonggui commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，哈薩克錫喇巴瑪及回人莽噶裏克率眾襲將軍和起于辟展。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Kazakh Sira Bama and the Muslim Manggalik led forces to attack General Heqi at Pizhan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Sira Bama and Manggalik assaulted Heqi at Pizhan.

sentences.zh: 和起力戰死之，命如傅清、拉布敦例恤。

translations.literal: Heqi fought fiercely and died; he was ordered mourned with posthumous honors like Fu Qing and Labudun.
translations.idiomatic: Heqi died in battle; obsequies were granted on Fu Qing and Labudun's precedent.

sentences.zh: 己未，黃廷桂奏備馬三萬匹，增兵駐哈密等處。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Huang Tinggui memorialized that thirty thousand horses had been prepared and troops increased at Hami and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Huang Tinggui reported thirty thousand horses ready and reinforcements at Hami.

sentences.zh: 上以「明決擔當」嘉之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his clear decisiveness and willingness to shoulder responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli praised his bold, responsible planning.

sentences.zh: 賞黃廷桂雙眼花翎、騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Huang Tinggui was rewarded with a double-eyed peacock feather and a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry post.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Tinggui received double peacock feathers and a hereditary commandantcy.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，王安國病免。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Wang Anguo was excused on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Wang Anguo left office ill.

sentences.zh: 以汪由敦署吏部尚書，趙弘恩署工部尚書，何國宗署左都御史。

translations.literal: Wang Youdun was ordered acting Minister of Personnel; Zhao Hong'en acting Minister of Works; He Guozong acting Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Youdun acted at Personnel; Zhao Hong'en at Works; He Guozong at the censorate.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子朔，策楞、玉保逮京，途次為額魯特人所害。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day jiazi: Celeng and Yubao, being escorted to the capital, were killed en route by Eleuths.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth-month new moon, Celeng and Yubao were slain by Eleuths while under escort to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賑山西汾陽等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, relief was given for flood in Shanxi counties including Fenyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Fenyang and other Shanxi flood counties were relieved.

sentences.zh: 辛未，諭哲布尊丹巴胡圖克圖加號敷教安眾喇嘛。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, an edict added the title Fushu Anzhong Lama to the Jebtsundampa Khutuktu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Jebtsundampa received the added title Fushu Anzhong Lama.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以盧焯為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Lu Chao was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Lu Chao became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 賑山東金鄉等二十一州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood in twenty-one Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Jinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-one Shandong districts including Jinxiang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，免陝西盩厔等四縣本年水災民屯額賦、馬廠地額賦之半。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, half of this year's quota taxes on civilian colonies and stud farms was remitted for flood in four Shaanxi counties including Zhouzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, four Shaanxi flood counties lost half their colony and stud-farm taxes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，獲青滾雜卜于杭噶獎噶斯，賞成袞紮布黃帶，封子一人為世子，封納木紮勒一等伯。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Qinggunjab was captured at Hangga Jianggas; Chengun Zhabu was granted the yellow belt; one son was enfeoffed as heir; Namuzhale was made a first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Qinggunjab was taken; Chengun Zhabu got the yellow belt; Namuzhale became a first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 己卯，召瑚圖靈阿等回京。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Hutuling'a and others were summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Hutuling'a and others were recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以獲青滾雜卜功，晉貝勒車木楚克紮布郡王品級，賞貝勒旺布多爾濟等雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: For capturing Qinggunjab, Prince Chemuchuk Zhabu was advanced to junwang rank; Prince Wangbu Dorji and others were granted double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Chemuchuk Zhabu was raised to junwang and Wangbu Dorji received double peacock feathers for taking Qinggunjab.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，達勒党阿罷協辦大學士，以鄂彌達代之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Daledang'a was relieved of his concurrent Grand Council post; Erimida replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Daledang'a left the Grand Council and Erimida took his seat.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月甲午，以南巡免江蘇、安徽、浙江累年逋賦。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, spring, first month, day jiawu: because of the southern tour, accumulated arrears were remitted in Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year's first month, on jiawu day, Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang arrears were forgiven for the southern tour.

sentences.zh: 以成袞紮布為定邊將軍，由巴里坤進剿，車布登紮佈署北路定邊左副將軍，舒赫德、富德、鄂實為參贊大臣，色布騰巴勒珠爾、阿裏袞、明瑞等為領隊大臣。

translations.literal: Chengun Zhabu was made Pacification General on the Frontier and ordered to advance from Barkul in suppression; Chebudeng Zhab acted as Northern Route Left Deputy General; Shuhede, Fude, and Eshi were campaign commissioners; Sebten Balzhur, Argun, Mingrui, and others were lead officers.
translations.idiomatic: Chengun Zhabu became frontier pacification general from Barkul; Chebudeng Zhab, Shuhede, Fude, and Eshi took command posts; Sebten, Argun, and Mingrui led columns.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賑江蘇清河等十九州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, relief was given for flood in nineteen Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, nineteen Jiangsu flood districts including Qinghe were relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，命嵩椿為荊州將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Song Chun was made Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Song Chun became Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 以莽古賚為參贊大臣，赴北路軍營。

translations.literal: Manggu Lai was made campaign commissioner and sent to the Northern Route army camp.
translations.idiomatic: Manggu Lai became commissioner on the northern front.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命哈達哈為參贊大臣，駐科布多。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Hadaha was made campaign commissioner and stationed at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Hadaha became commissioner at Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以哈甯阿、永貴為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Haning'a and Yonggui were made campaign commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Haning'a and Yonggui became commissioners.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上奉皇太后南巡。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, set out on the southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager began the southern tour.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，授汪由敦吏部尚書，調何國宗為禮部尚書，秦蕙田為工部尚書，趙弘恩仍回左副都御史，白鍾山為江南河道總督，張師載為河東河道總督，楊錫紱為漕運總督，授愛必達江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Wang Youdun was appointed Minister of Personnel; He Guozong was transferred to Minister of Rites; Qin Huitian to Minister of Works; Zhao Hong'en returned to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief; Bai Zhongshan to Jiangnan Canal Governor-General; Zhang Shizai to Hedong Canal Governor-General; Yang Xifu to Grain Transport Governor-General; and Aibida was appointed Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Wang Youdun, He Guozong, Qin Huitian, Zhao Hong'en, Bai Zhongshan, Zhang Shizai, Yang Xifu, and Aibida received new posts.

sentences.zh: 丙午，免直隸靜海等三州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, arrears were remitted in three Zhili prefectures and counties including Jinghai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, three Zhili districts including Jinghai lost arrears.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免經過直隸、山東地方本年錢糧十分之三，被災地方十分之五。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, thirty percent of this year's grain taxes along the route in Zhili and Shandong were remitted, and fifty percent in disaster areas.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, route taxes in Zhili and Shandong were cut thirty percent, fifty in disaster counties.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賑山東濟寧五州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day renzi, relief was given for flood in five Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, five Shandong districts including Jining received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以阿思哈為北路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Asiha was made Northern Route campaign commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Asiha became northern commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，以嵇璜為江南副總河。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Ji Huang was made Jiangnan deputy canal director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Ji Huang became Jiangnan deputy canal director.

sentences.zh: 命阿桂留烏裏雅蘇台辦事。

translations.literal: Agui was ordered to remain at Uliyasutai on business.
translations.idiomatic: Agui stayed at Uliyasutai on assignment.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，噶勒藏多爾濟、達什車淩等叛。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Galdan Dorji, Dashizhuling, and others rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Galdan Dorji and Dashizhuling rebelled.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥朔，免經過江南、浙江地方本年錢糧十分之三，被災地方十分之五。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day guihai: thirty percent of this year's grain taxes along the Jiangsu and Zhejiang route were remitted, and fifty percent in disaster areas.
translations.idiomatic: On the second-month new moon, Jiangsu and Zhejiang route taxes were cut thirty percent, fifty in disaster areas.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賑江蘇清河十四州縣衛、安徽宿州等四州縣衛災民。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, disaster victims were relieved in fourteen Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Qinghe and in four Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, flood victims in Jiangsu and Anhui received relief.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，兆惠全師至烏魯木齊，封一等伯，世襲。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zhaohui's entire force reached Urumqi; he was enfeoffed as a first-class baron with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Zhaohui reached Urumqi and received a hereditary first-class baronage.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上奉皇太后渡河至天妃閘，閱木龍。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, crossed the river to Tianfei Lock and inspected the timber pilings.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager crossed to Tianfei Lock to inspect river pilings.

sentences.zh: 免江南乾隆十年以前漕項積欠。

translations.literal: Jiangnan grain-transport arrears before Qianlong 10 were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Pre-Qianlong-10 Jiangnan transport arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 免兩淮灶戶乾隆十七年至十九年未完折價銀兩。

translations.literal: Unpaid conversion silver owed by Liang-Huai salt producers from Qianlong 17 through 19 was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Liang-Huai salt producers' Qianlong 17–19 conversion arrears were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上奉皇太后渡江。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸宋臣范仲淹高義園。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the court visited the Gaoyi Garden of the Song minister Fan Zhongyan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the court visited Fan Zhongyan's Gaoyi Garden.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上奉皇太后幸蘇州府。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, arrived at Suzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager reached Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上奉皇太后臨視織造機房。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, inspected the weaving workshops.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager inspected Suzhou weaving shops.

sentences.zh: 調富森為吏部尚書，以納木劄勒為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Fusen was transferred to Minister of Personnel; Namuzhale to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Fusen became Personnel minister; Namuzhale Works minister.

sentences.zh: 降阿裏袞為侍郎，以兆惠為戶部尚書、領侍衛內大臣，舒赫德為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Argun was demoted to vice minister; Zhaohui was made Minister of Revenue and inner-court guard grand minister; Shuhede Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Argun was demoted; Zhaohui took Revenue and inner guard rank; Shuhede War.

sentences.zh: 命成袞紮布、兆惠分路捕剿額魯特叛眾。

translations.literal: Chengun Zhabu and Zhaohui were ordered to pursue Eleuth rebels on separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Chengun Zhabu and Zhaohui were to hunt Eleuth rebels by separate columns.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上閱兵於嘉興府後教場。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor reviewed troops at the rear drill ground of Jiaxing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Hongli reviewed troops at Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上閱兵于石門鎮。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor reviewed troops at Shimen garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Hongli reviewed troops at Shimen.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上奉皇太后幸杭州府。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, arrived at Hangzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager reached Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上閱兵。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor reviewed troops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Hongli reviewed troops.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免山東齊河等三州縣民欠，及山西汾陽等二縣、江蘇清河等十二州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, commoners' arrears were remitted in three Shandong prefectures and counties including Qihe, in two Shanxi counties including Fenyang, and quota taxes were remitted for flood in twelve Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, arrears and flood taxes were forgiven in Shandong, Shanxi, and Jiangsu districts.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，噶勒藏多爾濟陷伊犁，命成袞紮布討之。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou: Galdan Dorji seized Yili; Chengun Zhabu was ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingyou day, Galdan Dorji took Yili and Chengun Zhabu was sent against him.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上奉皇太后駐蹕蘇州府。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, halted at Suzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager stopped at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上奉皇太后幸江甯府。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, arrived at Jiangning prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager reached Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 免江南之江甯、蘇州，浙江之杭州三府附郭諸縣本年額賦。

translations.literal: This year's quota taxes were remitted for the suburban counties of Nanjing and Suzhou in Jiangsu and Hangzhou in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Suburban Nanjing, Suzhou, and Hangzhou lost this year's quota tax.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上奠明太祖陵。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor performed rites at the tomb of Ming Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Hongli worshipped at Ming Taizu's tomb.

sentences.zh: 輝特台吉車布登多爾濟叛，哈達哈討獲之。

translations.literal: The Khalkha taiji Chebudeng Dorji rebelled; Hadaha captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Taiji Chebudeng Dorji rebelled and was taken by Hadaha.

sentences.zh: 命盡誅丁壯，以女口賞喀爾喀。

translations.literal: An order was issued to execute all adult males and distribute the women as rewards to the Khalkhas.
translations.idiomatic: All rebel men were to be killed; women were given to the Khalkhas.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以哈達哈為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Hadaha was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Hadaha became War minister.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上奉皇太后渡江。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，召原任大學士史貽直入閣辦事，黃廷桂仍以大學士兼管陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, former Grand Secretary Shi Yizhi was summoned to the Grand Council; Huang Tinggui remained Grand Secretary and concurrently Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Shi Yizhi rejoined the council; Huang Tinggui kept grand secretary and Shaan-Gan duties.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，免陝西潼關等廳州縣上年水雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, last year's quota taxes were remitted for flood and hail in Shaanxi prefectures, departments, and counties including Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Shaanxi flood and hail counties including Tongguan were tax-exempt.

sentences.zh: 召劉統勳赴行在。

translations.literal: Liu Tongxun was summoned to the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tongxun was called to the imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 己未，上奉皇太后渡河。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Hongli and the Empress Dowager crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌朔，直隸總督方觀承劾奏巡檢張若瀛擅責內監僧人。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day renxu: Zhili governor-general Fang Guancheng impeached inspector Zhang Ruoying for improperly punishing an inner-palace eunuch monk.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth-month new moon, Fang Guancheng impeached Zhang Ruoying for chastising an eunuch monk.

sentences.zh: 上斥為不識大體，仍諭內監在外生事者聽人責懲。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked this as lacking broad view, yet also edicted that eunuchs who caused trouble outside might be punished by others.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli called the impeachment narrow-minded but allowed outsiders to punish meddlesome eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，免江蘇淮安等三府州地畝額賦。

translations.literal: On day yichou, land quota taxes were remitted in three Jiangsu prefectures and departments including Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, three Huai districts lost land quota tax.

sentences.zh: 命劉統勳督修徐州石工，侍郎夢麟督修六塘以下河工，副總河嵇璜督修昭關滾壩支河，均會同督、撫、總河籌辦。

translations.literal: Liu Tongxun was ordered to supervise Xuzhou stone works; Vice Minister Meng Lin the works below Liutang; deputy canal director Ji Huang the Zhaoguan rolling-dam branch river—all jointly with governors, governor-generals, and the canal commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tongxun, Meng Lin, and Ji Huang were assigned river repairs with provincial and canal chiefs.

sentences.zh: 召成袞紮布、兆惠、舒赫德等來京，以雅爾哈善為參贊大臣，掌定邊右副將軍印，命阿裏袞駐巴里坤辦事。

translations.literal: Chengun Zhabu, Zhaohui, and Shuhede were summoned to the capital; Yarhashan was made campaign commissioner holding the western deputy general's seal; Argun was ordered to remain at Barkul on business.
translations.idiomatic: Chengun Zhabu, Zhaohui, and Shuhede were recalled; Yarhashan took the western seal; Argun stayed at Barkul.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上至孫家集閱堤工。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor reached Sunjiaji to inspect dike works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Hongli inspected dikes at Sunjiaji.

sentences.zh: 唐喀祿獲車布登多爾濟，以普爾普部人賞烏梁海。

translations.literal: Tang Kalu captured Chebudeng Dorji; Pulupu's tribesmen were distributed as rewards to the Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Kalu took Chebudeng Dorji; Pulupu's people were given to the Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上渡河，至荊山橋、韓莊閘閱河工。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor crossed the river and inspected works at Jingshan Bridge and Hanzhuang Lock.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Hongli crossed the river and inspected Jingshan Bridge and Hanzhuang Lock.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，免直隸延慶等州縣衛二十一年雹災水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, quota taxes were remitted for hail and flood in year 21 in Zhili prefectures, counties, and guards including Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Zhili year-21 hail and flood taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚午，減山東海豐縣屬黎敬等五莊糧額，並免十一年至二十年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the grain quota for five villages under Haifeng county including Lijing was reduced, and arrears from years 11 through 20 were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Haifeng village quotas were cut and eleven-to-twenty arrears forgiven.

sentences.zh: 以松阿裏為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Song'ari was made Suiyuan garrison general.
translations.idiomatic: Song'ari became Suiyuan commander.

sentences.zh: 獲普爾普。

translations.literal: Pulupu was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Pulupu was taken.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上至闕里釋奠先師孔子。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor performed the sacrifice to Confucius at Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Hongli sacrificed to Confucius at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后駐蹕靈岩。

translations.literal: The Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, halted at Lingyan.
translations.idiomatic: Hongli and the Empress Dowager stopped at Lingyan.

sentences.zh: 命史貽直仍以文淵閣大學士兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Shi Yizhi was ordered to remain Wenyuan Hall Grand Secretary and concurrently Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yizhi kept Wenyuan grand secretary rank and Personnel as well.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，改松阿裏為涼州將軍，以保德為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Song'ari was transferred to Liangzhou general; Baode to Suiyuan garrison general.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Song'ari went to Liangzhou and Baode to Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免山東濟寧等五州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, arrears were remitted in five Shandong prefectures and counties including Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, five Shandong districts including Jining lost arrears.

sentences.zh: 己卯，調蔣炳為河南巡撫，以阿思哈為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Jiang Bing was transferred to Henan governor; Asiha to Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Jiang Bing took Henan and Asiha Hunan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，免河南夏邑等四縣逋賦。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, arrears were remitted in four Henan counties including Xiayi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, four Henan counties including Xiayi lost arrears.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以夏邑生員段昌緒藏吳三桂偽檄，命方觀承赴河南會同圖勒炳阿嚴鞫之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, because the Xiayi licentiate Duan Changxu had hidden a forged placard of Wu Sangui, Fang Guancheng was ordered to Henan to join Tulebing'a in a rigorous trial.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Duan Changxu's hoard of a Wu Sangui forgery sent Fang Guancheng to Henan with Tulebing'a for strict trial.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，何國宗罷。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, He Guozong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, He Guozong lost office.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Hongli returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命秦蕙田署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Qin Huitian was ordered acting Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Huitian acted at Rites.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以前布政使彭家屏藏明末野史，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, because former provincial treasurer Peng Jiaping had hoarded unofficial histories of the late Ming, he was stripped of office and arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, ex-treasurer Peng Jiaping was dismissed and jailed for hoarding late-Ming unofficial histories.

sentences.zh: 以歸宣光為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Gui Xuangang was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Xuangang became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，福建廈門火。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, a fire broke out at Xiamen in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Xiamen in Fujian caught fire.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上詣藍靛廠迎皇太后居申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor went to the Blue Indigo Works to welcome the Empress Dowager to residence at the Shenyong Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor met the Empress Dowager at Blue Indigo Works and lodged her at Shenyong Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賜蔡以台等二百四十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Cai Yitai and two hundred forty-two others were granted jinshi with rank and origin in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, two hundred forty-two new jinshi including Cai Yitai received graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁未，霍集占叛，副都統阿敏道死之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Huojizhan rebelled and Vice Commander-in-Chief A Mindao died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Huojizhan rebelled and A Mindao was killed.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉朔，以胡寶瑔為河南巡撫，阿思哈署江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day xinyou: Hu Baojun was made Henan governor; Asheha acted as Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Hu Baojun became Henan governor and Asheha acted in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，免甘肅及河南夏邑等四縣明年額賦。

translations.literal: On day renxu, next year's registered taxes were remitted for Gansu and four counties including Xiayi in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, next year's taxes were forgiven in Gansu and four Henan counties.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以愛必達為雲貴總督，調陳宏謀為江蘇巡撫，明德為陝西巡撫，定長為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Ebidai was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Chen Hongmou was transferred to Jiangsu governor, Mingde to Shaanxi governor, and Ding Chang to Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Ebidai took Yunnan-Guizhou; Chen Hongmou, Mingde, and Ding Chang were shifted to Jiangsu, Shaanxi, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賑河南鄢陵等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, flood relief was granted for Yanling and other districts in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Henan flood districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，彭家屏論斬。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Peng Jiaping was sentenced to decapitation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Peng Jiaping was condemned to be beheaded.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賞達什達瓦部落兩月口糧。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, two months' rations were granted to Dashdawa's tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Dashdawa's tribe received two months' grain.

sentences.zh: 癸未，喀爾喀達瑪琳叛，命桑寨多爾濟討之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Khalkha Damalin rebelled; Sangsa Dorji was ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Damalin of Khalkha rebelled and Sangsa Dorji was sent against him.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賑安徽宿州等十六州縣衛水災、甘肅碾伯等三十八州縣廳水雹災。

translations.literal: On day jichou, flood relief was granted for sixteen Anhui districts including Suzhou and hail relief for thirty-eight Gansu districts including Nianbo.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, flood and hail relief reached Anhui and Gansu in large numbers.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯朔，賑山東館陶等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on day xinmao: flood relief was granted for Guantao and other districts in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Shandong flood districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以劉藻為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Liu Zao was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Liu Zao became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賜彭家屏自盡。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Peng Jiaping was granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Peng Jiaping was allowed to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 命史貽直仍兼工部。

translations.literal: Shi Yizhi was ordered to continue concurrently administering the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yizhi was kept in concurrent charge of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賑安徽宿州等十州縣水災雹災。

translations.literal: On day yisi, flood and hail relief was granted for ten Anhui districts including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, ten Anhui districts received flood and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賑山東東平州等五州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, flood relief was granted for five Shandong districts including Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, five Shandong districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 以獲巴雅爾授富德內大臣，封貝勒羅布藏多爾濟為郡王。

translations.literal: Bayar, taken captive, was granted to Fu De as inner chamberlain; Beile Luobuzangdorji was enfeoffed as prince of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: Captive Bayar was given to Fu De; Beile Luobuzangdorji was raised to junwang rank.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以楊應琚為閩浙總督，以鶴年為兩廣總督，蔣洲為山東巡撫，塔永甯為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Yang Yingju was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Yihenian Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general, Jiang Zhou Shandong governor, and Ta Yongning Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Yang Yingju, Yihenian, Jiang Zhou, and Ta Yongning received four governor posts.

sentences.zh: 哈薩克汗阿布賚遣使入貢。

translations.literal: The Kazakh khan Abulai sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kazakh Khan Abulai presented tribute through envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上奉皇太后巡幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor, attending the Empress Dowager, toured Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the imperial party toured Mulan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，額魯特台吉渾齊等殺劄那噶爾布，以其首來降。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Oirat taiji Hunqi and others killed Zanagarbu and came in surrender with his head.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Hunqi's party killed Zanagarbu and surrendered with his head.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑山東濟寧等三十二州縣衛水災、福建龍嚴等二州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, flood relief was granted for thirty-two Shandong districts including Jining and two Fujian districts including Longyan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, flood relief reached Shandong and Fujian districts.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，哈薩克霍集伯爾根等降。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingyin: Kazakh Khojiberken and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Kazakh leaders including Khojiberken submitted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以薩喇善為吉林將軍，傅森署之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Salashan was made Jilin general; Fusen acted for him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Salashan became Jilin general with Fusen as acting.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賑甘肅柳溝等三衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, drought relief was granted for three Gansu garrisons including Liugou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, three Gansu garrisons received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上奉皇太后巡幸木蘭，行圍。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor, attending the Empress Dowager, toured Mulan and conducted a hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the court hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 賑山西汾陽水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was granted for Fenyang in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi's Fenyang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，巴雅爾、達什車淩伏誅。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Bayar and Dashiceling were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Bayar and Dashiceling were put to death.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，克埒特、烏嚕特各部俱平。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guisi: the Kereit and Uliut tribes were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Kereit and Uliut tribes were fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上御行殿，哈薩克阿布賚等使臣入覲，賜宴。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, at the traveling palace the Emperor received envoys of Kazakh Abulai and others in audience and granted a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Kazakh envoys were received in audience and feasted.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以富勒渾為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Fulehun was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Fulehun became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 琿齊等復叛。

translations.literal: Hunqi and others rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Hunqi's party rose again.

sentences.zh: 庚子，額魯特沙喇斯、瑪呼斯二宰桑叛，命都統滿福討之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Oirat zaisang Shalas and Mahusi rebelled; Commander-in-Chief Manfu was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, two Oirat zaisang rebelled and Manfu was dispatched against them.

sentences.zh: 以雅爾哈善為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Yaerhashan was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Yaerhashan became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上奉皇太后回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor, attending the Empress Dowager, returned to lodge at the Mountain Resort.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the court returned to the Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，磔尼瑪等於故將軍和起墓前。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Nima and others were dismembered before the tomb of the late General Heqi.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Nima's party suffered lingchi at Heqi's tomb.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命劉統勳赴山東、江南辦理河工。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Liu Tongxun was ordered to Shandong and Jiangnan to manage river works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Liu Tongxun was sent to oversee rivers in Shandong and Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor, attending the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the imperial party returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，上幸南苑，行圍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: the Emperor visited the Southern Park and conducted a hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Emperor hunted in the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Ryukyu presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以雅爾哈善署定邊右副將軍。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Yaerhashan was made acting Pacification Commissioner on the Right for the Border.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Yaerhashan acted as right border deputy general.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召車布登紮布來京，以納木紮勒署定邊左副將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Chebudengzhabu was summoned to the capital; Namuzhale acted as Pacification Commissioner on the Left for the Border.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Chebudengzhabu was called to court and Namuzhale acted as left border deputy general.

sentences.zh: 阿桂赴科布多，以莽古賚為北路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: A Gui went to Kobdo; Mangubai was made Northern Route participating minister.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui proceeded to Kobdo and Mangubai became northern-route coordinator.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以兆惠為定邊將軍，車布登紮布為定邊右副將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Zhaohui was made Pacification General for the Border; Chebudengzhabu was made Pacification Commissioner on the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Zhaohui became border general and Chebudengzhabu his right deputy.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以永貴為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Yonggui was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Yonggui became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，以喀爾喀親王德沁紮布為北路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingshen: Khalkha Prince Dexinjab was made Northern Route participating minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Prince Dexinjab became northern-route coordinator.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以吳拜為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Wu Bai was made Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Wu Bai became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑甘肅皋蘭等二十二廳州縣霜雹等災。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, frost and hail relief was granted for twenty-two Gansu districts including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, twenty-two Gansu districts received frost and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，以陳宏謀為兩廣總督，李侍堯署之，讬恩多為江蘇巡撫，阿勒泰為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai: Chen Hongmou was made Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general with Li Shiyao acting; Tuoenduo was made Jiangsu governor and Aletai Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Chen Hongmou, Li Shiyao, Tuoenduo, and Aletai received southern posts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大學士陳世倌乞休，許之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Grand Secretary Chen Shiguan requested retirement and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Chen Shiguan's retirement was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，封車木楚克紮布為郡王。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Chemuchukezhabu was enfeoffed as prince of the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Chemuchukezhabu was made a junwang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賑紮嚕特、阿嚕、科爾沁三旗災。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, disaster relief was granted for the Zhalute, Aru, and Horqin banners.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, three banners received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，舒赫德以失機褫職。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Shuhede was stripped of office for military failure.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Shuhede lost his post for mishandling the campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲申，加史貽直、陳世倌太子太傅，鄂彌達、劉統勳太子太保。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Shi Yizhi and Chen Shiguan were advanced to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; Emin Da and Liu Tongxun to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, four ministers received heir-apparent honors.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、暹羅、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Korea, Siam, and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute missions came from Korea, Siam, and Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月己丑，賑河南衛輝等府屬災民一月。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, spring, first month, day jichou: one month's relief was granted for disaster victims in Henan prefectures including Weihui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year's first month, Henan victims received a month of relief.

sentences.zh: 免甘肅乾隆十六年至二十二年逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears of registered taxes from Qianlong 16 through 22 were remitted in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu tax arrears from years sixteen through twenty-two were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命兆惠、車布登紮布剿沙喇伯勒，雅爾哈善、額敏和卓征回部。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Zhaohui and Chebudengzhabu were ordered against Shalabole; Yaerhashan and Emin Hezhuo were ordered to campaign in the Muslim west.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, western campaigns were assigned to Zhaohui's and Yaerhashan's columns.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑江蘇清河等十八州縣、安徽宿州等十州縣災民有差。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, disaster victims in eighteen Jiangsu districts including Qinghe and ten Anhui districts including Suzhou received relief in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Jiangsu and Anhui victims received graded relief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賑直隸大名等州縣災民。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, disaster victims in Zhili districts including Daming received relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Zhili disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以俄羅斯呈驗阿睦爾撒納屍及哈薩克稱臣納貢，宣諭中外。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, because Russia presented Amursana's corpse for inspection and the Kazakhs submitted as vassals with tribute, an edict was proclaimed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Russia's exhibit and Kazakh submission were announced empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 己酉，吏部尚書汪由敦卒，上親臨賜奠。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Personnel Minister Wang Youdun died; the Emperor attended in person to grant mourning offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Wang Youdun died and the Emperor mourned him in person.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以劉統勳為吏部尚書，調秦蕙田為刑部尚書，以嵇璜為工部尚書，調鍾音為廣東巡撫，周琬為福建巡撫，周人驥署貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Liu Tongxun was made Personnel Minister; Qin Huitian was transferred to Minister of Punishments; Ji Huang was made Minister of Works; Zhong Yin was transferred to Guangdong governor; Zhou Wan was made Fujian governor; Zhou Renji acted as Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, six ministries and governorships were reassigned.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命雅爾哈善為靖逆將軍，額敏和卓、哈甯阿為參贊大臣，順德訥、愛隆阿、玉素布為領隊大臣，征回部。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Yaerhashan was made Pacification General for Suppressing Rebels; Emin Hezhuo and Haning'a were made participating ministers; Shunden'e, Ailong'a, and Yusubu were made lead commanders—to campaign in the Muslim west.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yaerhashan was sent west with Emin Hezhuo and three lead commanders.

sentences.zh: 命永貴、定長以欽差大臣關防辦理屯田事務。

translations.literal: Yonggui and Ding Chang were ordered to handle garrison farming under imperial commissioner seals.
translations.idiomatic: Yonggui and Ding Chang were commissioned for frontier farming.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑陝西葭州等八州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day guihai, drought relief was granted for eight Shaanxi districts including Jiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, eight Shaanxi districts received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賑德州等三十七州縣衛所災民。

translations.literal: On day yichou, disaster victims in thirty-seven districts including Dezhou received relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, thirty-seven districts including Dezhou were relieved.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Emperor worshipped at the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor visited Zhaoxi, Xiao, Xiaodong, and Jing tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor worshipped at four imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor visited the Tai Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor worshipped at Taizong's tomb.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，兆惠等進兵沙喇伯勒，獲紮哈沁哈拉拜，盡殲其眾。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Zhaohui advanced on Shalabole, captured Zhahakin Halabai, and annihilated his force.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Zhaohui destroyed Halabai's band at Shalabole.

sentences.zh: 舍楞遁，命和碩齊、唐喀祿追捕之。

translations.literal: Sheling fled; Hesuoqi and Tangkalu were ordered to pursue him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheling escaped and two officers were sent in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，免江蘇山陽等二十五州縣衛額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day renyin, registered taxes were remitted in varying degrees for twenty-five Jiangsu districts including Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, twenty-five Jiangsu districts had taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禦試翰林、詹事等官，擢王鳴盛等三員為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the palace examination of Hanlin and Household officials was held; Wang Mingsheng and two others were ranked first class, the rest promoted or demoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the palace exam ranked Wang Mingsheng and two others top.

sentences.zh: 試由部院改入翰林等官，擢德爾泰為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: Officials transferred from ministries into Hanlin were examined; Deertai was ranked first class, the rest adjusted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred officials were examined; Deertai ranked first.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以吳士功為福建巡撫，鍾音為陝西巡撫，托恩多為廣東巡撫，莊有恭署江蘇巡撫，馮鈐為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Wu Shigong was made Fujian governor; Zhong Yin Shaanxi governor; Tuoenduo Guangdong governor; Zhuang Yougong acted as Jiangsu governor; Feng Ling Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, five governorships were reassigned.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌，免甘肅蘭州等六府州縣乾隆三年至十年逋賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renxu: arrears from Qianlong 3 through 10 were remitted in six Gansu prefectures including Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Gansu tax arrears through year ten were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，復封額駙色布騰巴勒珠爾為親王。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the imperial son-in-law Sebutengbalzhu'er was re-enfeoffed as prince of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Sebutengbalzhu'er's princedom was restored.

sentences.zh: 免直隸霸州等三十三州縣廳乾隆十年至二十年逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears from Qianlong 10 through 20 were remitted in thirty-three Zhili districts including Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-three Zhili districts had decade-long arrears forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚午，致仕大學士陳世倌卒。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, retired Grand Secretary Chen Shiguan died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the retired Grand Secretary Chen Shiguan died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命李元亮兼署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Li Yuanliang was ordered concurrently to act as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Li Yuanliang acted as Revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 免直隸魏縣等二十九州縣廳上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Last year's flood tax quotas were remitted in twenty-nine Zhili districts including Wei County.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-nine Zhili districts had flood-year taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命陳宏謀回江蘇，以總督銜管巡撫事。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Chen Hongmou was ordered back to Jiangsu to handle governor affairs with governor-general rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Chen Hongmou returned to run Jiangsu with vice-regal rank.

sentences.zh: 以馮鈐為湖南巡撫，莊有恭署湖北巡撫，李侍堯署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Feng Ling was made Hunan governor; Zhuang Yougong acted in Hubei; Li Shiyao acted in Guangdong-Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ling, Zhuang Yougong, and Li Shiyao received three southern posts.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以旱命刑部清理庶獄，減徒以下罪，直隸如之。

translations.literal: On day renwu, because of drought the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to clear common prisons and reduce punishments below exile; Zhili followed likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, drought prompted prison review and sentence reductions.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，免甘肅通省二十四年額賦。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuzi: the twenty-fourth year's registered taxes were remitted for all Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Gansu's year-twenty-four taxes were forgiven province-wide.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賑陝西延安等三府州旱災。

translations.literal: On day guichou, drought relief was granted for three Shaanxi prefectures including Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yan'an and other Shaanxi districts received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，免陝西榆林等八州縣逋賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinwei: tax arrears were remitted in eight Shaanxi districts including Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, eight Shaanxi districts had arrears forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸未，免陝西靖邊等八州縣上年額賦。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, last year's registered taxes were remitted in eight Shaanxi districts including Jingbian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, eight Shaanxi border districts had last year's taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 直隸元城等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts struck Yuancheng and other districts in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Locust plague hit Yuancheng and other Zhili districts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，免甘肅安西等三廳衛二十二年風災額賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai: wind-disaster taxes from year twenty-two were remitted in three Gansu posts including Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, three Gansu posts had wind-disaster taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己丑，毛城鋪河決。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Maochangpu River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Maochangpu River breached.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，霍集占援庫車，雅爾哈善等擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Huojizhan reinforced Kuche; Yaerhashan and others defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Huojizhan's Kuche relief was beaten back.

sentences.zh: 免福建臺灣縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Drought tax quotas were remitted for Taiwan County in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's Taiwan County had drought taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙申，加黃廷桂少保，楊應琚、開泰太子太保，楊錫紱太子少師，陳宏謀、高晉、胡寶瑔太子少傅，白鍾山、愛必達、吳達善太子少保。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Huang Tinggui was advanced to Junior Tutor; Yang Yingju and Kaitai to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Yang Xifu to Junior Preceptor; Chen Hongmou, Gao Jin, and Hu Baojun to Junior Tutor; Bai Zhongshan, Ebidai, and Wu Dashan to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, nine officials received heir-apparent honors.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賑山西靜樂等州縣水雹災。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, flood and hail relief was granted for Jingle and other districts of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Shanxi districts including Jingle received flood and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, conducted the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the court hunted at Mulan with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，舍楞奔俄羅斯。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Shele fled to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Shele escaped to Russia.

sentences.zh: 召阿桂還。

translations.literal: Agui was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Agui was summoned back to court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，右翼布魯特瑪木特呼裏比米隆遣其弟舍爾伯克入覲。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Mamuthu Khuribimirong of the Right Wing Buruts sent his younger brother Sherberke to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Right Wing Burut chief sent his brother Sherberke to court.

sentences.zh: 諭縛獻哈薩克錫喇。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sira of the Kazakhs bound and presented.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Kazakh Sira captured and sent in.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以納木劄勒為靖逆將軍，三泰為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Namuzhale was made Pacification General and Santi campaign assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Namuzhale became Pacification General and Santi his assistant.

sentences.zh: 諭兆惠赴庫車，丙午，上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Zhaohui was ordered to proceed to Kucha; on bingwu day the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui was sent to Kucha; on bingwu day the court halted at the Summer Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賞車布登紮布親王品級。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Chebudunjab was rewarded with princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Chebudunjab received princely rank.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賑陝西延安等十七州縣旱雹災。

translations.literal: On day renzi, drought and hail relief was granted for Yan'an and sixteen other districts of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, seventeen Shaanxi districts including Yan'an received drought and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，雨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingyin: it rained.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上奉皇太后幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, went to Mulan for a hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the court held a Mulan battue with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以都賚為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Du Lai was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Du Lai became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賑甘肅皋蘭等二十四州縣廳旱災。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, drought relief was granted for Gaolan and twenty-three other prefectures, counties, and subprefectures of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, twenty-four Gansu districts including Gaolan received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 壬午，緬甸國王莽達喇為得楞野夷所害，木梳鋪土官甕藉牙自立。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Burma's king Mangdala was killed by wild tribes of Deleng; Wengjiaya, native official of Mushu, seized power.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Burma's king was slain by frontier tribes and Wengjiaya of Mushu rose up.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，賜布魯特使臣舍爾伯克宴。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jichou: a banquet was given for the Burut envoy Sherberke.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jichou day, Sherberke of the Buruts was feasted.

sentences.zh: 提督馬得勝以攻庫車失機，處斬。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Ma Desheng was executed for losing the opportunity in the attack on Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Desheng was put to death for mishandling the assault on Kucha.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，右部哈薩克圖裏拜及塔什干回人圖爾占等來降。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Turibai of the Right Wing Kazakhs and Turgachan of Tashkent and other Muslims came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Kazakh and Tashkent leaders submitted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Empress Dowager halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Empress Dowager stayed at the Summer Mountain Resort.
