sentences.zh: 戊戌，調歸宣光為左都御史，以嵇璜為禮部尚書，命梁詩正署工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Gui Xuangguang was transferred to Left Censor-in-chief; Ji Huang was made Minister of Rites; Liang Shizheng was ordered to act as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Gui Xuangguang, Ji Huang, and acting Works Minister Liang Shizheng were appointed.

sentences.zh: 命駐防伊犁大臣兼理回部事務。

translations.literal: The garrison commander at Ili was ordered concurrently to manage Muslim-region affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Ili garrison chief was told to handle Muslim affairs as well.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑浙江仁和等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, flood relief was granted for Renhe and other counties of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Zhejiang flood districts including Renhe were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，哈喇哈勒巴克回部來降。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Muslims of Karakhalbakh came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Karakhalbakh Muslims submitted.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，和闐城伯克霍集斯等來降。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Khotan city beg Khojasi and others came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Khojasi of Khotan and other begs submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，烏什城降。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Ushi city surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Ushi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，賑浙江錢塘等十六縣場水災，山西朔平府屬霜災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guihai: flood relief was granted for Qiantang and fifteen other Zhejiang counties and salterns, and frost relief for districts under Shuoping Prefecture, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zhejiang flood and Shanxi frost districts received relief.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賑直隸大城等九縣水雹霜災。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, flood, hail, and frost relief was granted for Dacheng and eight other counties of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, nine Zhili counties received flood, hail, and frost relief.

sentences.zh: 兆惠自巴爾楚克進兵葉爾羌。

translations.literal: Zhaohui advanced from Barkul toward Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui marched from Barkul on Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，吳拜病免，以德敏為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Wu Bai was dismissed for illness and Demin was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, sick Wu Bai left office and Demin became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 賑直隸滄州等六州縣場水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was granted for Cangzhou and five other prefectures, counties, and salterns of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Six Zhili districts including Cangzhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申朔，右部哈薩克遣使來朝，賜宴。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day jiashen: the Right Wing Kazakhs sent envoys to court and were given a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh-month new moon of jiashen, Kazakh envoys were received and feasted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上回蹕。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the court returned from tour.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for a hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上大閱。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor conducted a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor held a grand military review.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以阿裏袞為參贊大臣，赴兆惠軍營。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Arigun was made campaign assistant commissioner and sent to Zhaohui's army camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Arigun joined Zhaohui's staff as assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑江蘇海州等五州縣水旱潮災。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, flood, drought, and tidal relief was granted for Haizhou and four other prefectures and counties of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, five Jiangsu districts including Haizhou received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，兆惠至葉爾羌城外，陷賊圍中。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Zhaohui reached outside Yarkand city and fell into the rebels' encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Zhaohui was trapped outside Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 授富德為定邊右副將軍，阿裏袞、愛隆阿、福祿、舒赫德為參贊大臣，往葉爾羌策應。

translations.literal: Fu De was made Pacification Assistant Commander of the Right on the Border; Arigun, Ailong'a, Fulu, and Shujede were made campaign assistant commissioners and sent to Yarkand to support operations.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De became border assistant commander; Arigun, Ailong'a, Fulu, and Shujede were sent as assistants to relieve Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以十二月朔望日月並蝕，諭修省。

translations.literal: On day jihai, because the new and full moons of the twelfth month would both be eclipsed, an edict called for self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, twin eclipses in the twelfth month prompted an edict of repentance.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，克裏雅伯克阿裏木沙來降。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Kucha beg Alimusha came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Kucha beg Alimusha submitted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以兆惠深入鏖戰，封一等武毅謀勇公，晉額敏和卓郡王品級，霍集斯貝子加貝勒品級。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, because Zhaohui had fought deep in enemy territory, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Martial Resolution and Strategic Courage of the first rank; the rank of the Emin Khoja prince was raised to commandery-prince level, and Khojasi's beile rank was raised to beile-of-the-first-rank level.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Zhaohui and Khojasi received major ennoblements for the Yarkand campaign.

sentences.zh: 丁未，納木紮勒、三泰、奎瑪岱策應兆惠，途次遇賊，死之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Namuzhale, Santi, and Kuimadai, moving to support Zhaohui, encountered rebels on the road and were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Namuzhale, Santi, and Kuimadai died fighting en route to Zhaohui.

sentences.zh: 加贈納木紮勒公爵、三泰子爵、奎瑪岱世職。

translations.literal: Namuzhale was posthumously advanced to duke; Santi to baron; Kuimadai was granted a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous honors went to Namuzhale, Santi, and Kuimadai.

sentences.zh: 以舒赫德為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Shujede was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Shujede became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，富德赴葉爾羌。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Fu De proceeded to Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Fu De marched to Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑朔，日蝕。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day guichou: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth-month new moon of guichou, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 左副都御史孫灝奏請明年停止巡幸，上斥其識見舛繆，改用三品京堂，並以「效法皇祖練武習勞」諭中外。

translations.literal: Left Vice Censor-in-chief Sun Hao memorialized asking to stop touring the following year; the Emperor rebuked his warped judgment, reduced him to third-rank metropolitan official, and issued an edict to court and country on "emulating the ancestral emperor in drilling troops and enduring hardship."
translations.idiomatic: Sun Hao's plea to end tours was rejected; he was demoted and the court was told to follow Qianlong's martial example.

sentences.zh: 賑福建臺灣等四縣風災。

translations.literal: Wind-disaster relief was granted for Taiwan and three other counties of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Four Fujian counties including Taiwan received wind relief.

sentences.zh: 加賑浙江仁和等七縣所水災。

translations.literal: Additional flood relief was granted for Renhe and six other counties and subprefectures of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Extra flood relief went to seven Zhejiang districts including Renhe.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，裘曰修罷軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Qiu Yixiu was removed from service at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Qiu Yixiu left Grand Council duty.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，除甘肅張掖等四廳縣水沖田畝額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, quota land tax was remitted for fields washed away in Zhangye and three other subprefectures and counties of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, flood-washed fields in four Gansu districts had quota tax remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，晉封喀爾喀扎薩克郡王齊巴克雅喇木丕勒為親王。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Khalkha jasak prince Chibakeyalamupile of Zasak was advanced to prince of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, a Khalkha jasak prince was raised to first-rank prince.

sentences.zh: 壬申，免浙江錢塘等七縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renshen, this year's flood quota tax was remitted for Qiantang and six other counties of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, seven Zhejiang counties including Qiantang had flood taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月甲申，免甘肅通省明年額賦及積年各項積欠。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, day jiashen: next year's quota tax and all accumulated arrears were remitted for the whole province of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year's first month, Gansu received full remission of next year's levy and all arrears.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雅爾哈善處斬。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yarhashan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Yarhashan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大學士伯黃廷桂卒，以吳達善為陝甘總督，明德為甘肅巡撫，暫護總督。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Grand Secretary Huang Tinggui died; Wu Dashan was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, Mingde Gansu governor acting governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Huang Tinggui died and Wu Dashan and Mingde received northwest posts.

sentences.zh: 授李侍堯兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Li Shiyao was appointed governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiyao became governor-general of the two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命蔣溥為大學士，仍管戶部尚書，梁詩正為兵部尚書，歸宣光為工部尚書，陳德華為左都御史，李元亮兼管兵部滿尚書，蘇昌署滿工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Jiang Pu was made Grand Secretary while remaining Minister of Revenue; Liang Shizheng Minister of War; Gui Xuangguang Minister of Works; Chen Dehua Left Censor-in-chief; Li Yuanliang concurrently managed the Manchu War Ministry; Suchang acted as Manchu Works Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Jiang Pu, Liang Shizheng, and other central ministers were appointed or shifted.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，哈甯阿論斬。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: Haning'a was sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu day, Haning'a was condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑車都布等三旗旱災。

translations.literal: On day guihai, drought relief was granted for the three banners of Chedub.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, three banners received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，富德、阿裏袞與霍集占戰呼爾璊，大敗之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Fu De and Arigun fought Hojijan at Gureng and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Fu De and Arigun routed Hojijan at Gureng.

sentences.zh: 封富德為三等伯，予舒赫德、阿裏袞、豆斌等世職。

translations.literal: Fu De was enfeoffed as a third-rank earl; Shujede, Arigun, Dou Bin, and others were granted hereditary offices.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De became a third-rank earl and several commanders received hereditary ranks.

sentences.zh: 命舒赫德回阿克蘇辦事。

translations.literal: Shujede was ordered back to Aksu to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shujede was sent back to manage affairs at Aksu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，富德兵至葉爾羌，會兆惠兵進攻。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Fu De's troops reached Yarkand and joined Zhaohui's forces in attack.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Fu De united with Zhaohui outside Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 晉封富德一等伯。

translations.literal: Fu De was advanced to first-rank earl.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De was raised to first-rank earl.

sentences.zh: 命車布登紮布為副將軍，福祿、車木楚克紮布為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Chebudunjab was made assistant commander; Fulu and Chemuchukejab were made campaign assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Chebudunjab, Fulu, and Chemuchukejab received frontier commands.

sentences.zh: 鄂斯滿等陷克裏雅。

translations.literal: Osuman and others seized Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: Osuman's faction took Kucha.

sentences.zh: 諭巴祿援和闐。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Balu to relieve Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: Balu was ordered to aid Khotan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以兆惠、富德回阿克蘇，嚴責之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, because Zhaohui and Fu De had returned to Aksu, they were severely rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Zhaohui and Fu De were sharply censured for withdrawing to Aksu.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，命舒赫德同霍集斯駐和闐，截賊竄路。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao: Shujede was ordered to station at Khotan with Khojasi and cut off the rebels' escape routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Shujede and Khojasi were posted at Khotan to block flight.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以頭等侍衛烏勒登、副都統齊努渾為北路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jichou, First-rank guardsman Uleden and Vice Commander-in-chief Qinuhun were made Northern Route campaign assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Uleden and Qinuhun became Northern Route assistants.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，召楊應琚來京，以楊廷璋署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Yang Yinggui was summoned to the capital; Yang Tingzhang acted as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Yang Yinggui was recalled and Yang Tingzhang acted in Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，彗星見。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, a comet was seen.

sentences.zh: 己亥，明瑞晉封承恩毅勇公。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Ming Rui was advanced to Duke who Inherits Grace with Resolute Courage.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Ming Rui was raised to Duke who Inherits Grace with Resolute Courage.

sentences.zh: 江蘇淮安等三府州蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts appeared in Huai'an and two other prefectures of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck three Jiangsu prefectures including Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，富德等援和闐。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinhai: Fu De and others relieved Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Fu De's force relieved Khotan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以阿桂為富德軍營參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Agui was made campaign assistant commissioner in Fu De's army camp.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Agui joined Fu De's staff as assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，常雩，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the regular summer solstice sacrifice was performed; Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the summer solstice rite was held at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 上以農田望澤，命停止鹵簿，步行虔禱。

translations.literal: Because the farmland longed for rain, the Emperor ordered the imperial escort suspended and walked in earnest prayer.
translations.idiomatic: For drought, the Emperor walked to pray without full ceremonial escort.

sentences.zh: 以楊應琚為陝甘總督，吳達善以總督銜管巡撫事。

translations.literal: Yang Yinggui was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general; Wu Dashan, with governor-general rank, managed provincial governor affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yinggui took Shaanxi-Gansu; Wu Dashan handled governorship duties with higher rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以楊廷璋為閩浙總督，莊有恭為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yang Tingzhang was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Zhuang Yougong Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Yang Tingzhang and Zhuang Yougong received southeast posts.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免浙江錢塘等十六縣場上年風災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, last year's wind-disaster quota tax was remitted for Qiantang and fifteen other Zhejiang counties and salterns.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, sixteen Zhejiang districts had last year's wind taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，展賑甘肅河州等處旱災。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, drought relief for Hezhou and other places in Gansu was extended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Gansu drought relief at Hezhou and elsewhere was prolonged.

sentences.zh: 命刑部清獄減刑，甘肅亦如之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Punishments was ordered to clear prisons and reduce punishments; Gansu was to do the same.
translations.idiomatic: A prison review and sentence reduction were ordered, including in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賑甘肅狄道等二十三廳州縣衛旱災雹災。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, drought and hail relief was granted for Didao and twenty-two other subprefectures, prefectures, counties, and guards of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, twenty-three Gansu districts including Didao received drought and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上臨原任大學士黃廷桂喪。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor went in person to the mourning hall of the late Grand Secretary Huang Tinggui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor attended Huang Tinggui's funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免山西陽曲等五州縣上年水災雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, last year's flood and hail quota tax was remitted for Yangqu and four other prefectures and counties of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, five Shanxi districts including Yangqu had flood and hail taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禁織造貢精巧絺繡。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, fine tribute silks woven for the palace were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, elaborate tribute gauzes and embroideries were banned.

sentences.zh: 命舒赫德仍回駐阿克蘇。

translations.literal: Shujede was again ordered to return and station at Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: Shujede was told to go back to Aksu.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，免陝西潼關等六十五廳州縣本年額賦有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: this year's quota tax was remitted with distinctions for Tongguan and sixty-four other subprefectures, prefectures, and counties of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Shaanxi quota taxes were remitted with distinctions in sixty-five districts.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑陝西咸寧等州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, drought relief was granted for Xianning and other prefectures and counties of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Shaanxi drought districts including Xianning were relieved.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔諸臣修省，仍直言得失。

translations.literal: On day jihai, an edict called on all ministers to examine themselves and still speak frankly of gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the court was told to reform and offer candid criticism.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上素服詣社稷壇祈雨。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, in plain dress the Emperor went to the Altar of Soil and Grain to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor prayed in plain dress at the Altar of Soil and Grain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上以雨澤未沛，不乘輦，不設鹵簿，由景運門步行祭方澤。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, because rain had not been ample, the Emperor did not ride the palanquin or use the full escort, but walked from Jingyun Gate to sacrifice at the Altar of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor walked without palanquin or full escort to the Altar of Earth for rain.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賑甘肅皋蘭等州縣被旱災民。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, drought victims in Gaolan and other districts of Gansu were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Gansu drought victims including Gaolan received relief.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，緩常犯奏請處決。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengxu: routine capital cases awaiting execution were deferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, ordinary death sentences were postponed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以恆祿為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Henglu was made general at Suiyuan city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Henglu became Suiyuan garrison general.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賑陝西榆林等十一州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, drought relief was granted for Yulin and ten other prefectures and counties of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, eleven Shaanxi districts including Yulin received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上以久旱，步至圜丘行大雩禮。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, because of prolonged drought, the Emperor walked to the Circular Mound to perform the great rain-prayer rite.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor walked to the Circular Mound for the great rain sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 是日，大雨。

translations.literal: That day, heavy rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 命兆惠進兵喀什噶爾，富德進兵葉爾羌。

translations.literal: Zhaohui was ordered to advance on Kashgar and Fude on Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: Orders went to Zhaohui for Kashgar and Fude for Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，江蘇海州等州縣、山東蘭山等縣蝗，諭裘曰修、海明捕蝗。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, locusts struck Haizhou and other Jiangsu districts and Lanshan and other Shandong counties; Qiu Yuexiu and Haiming were instructed to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, locusts hit Jiangsu and Shandong districts and Qiu Yuexiu and Haiming were told to fight them.

sentences.zh: 丙子，英吉利商船赴寧波貿易，莊有恭奏卻之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, an English merchant ship went to Ningbo to trade; Zhuang Yougong memorialized that it be turned away.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, an English ship sought trade at Ningbo and Zhuang Yougong had it refused.

sentences.zh: 諭李侍堯傳集外商，示以禁約。

translations.literal: Li Shiyao was instructed to summon foreign merchants and show them the prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiyao was told to gather foreign traders and read them the restrictions.

sentences.zh: 閏六月丙戌，免福建臺灣等三縣上年風災額賦。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day bingxu: quota tax for last year was remitted for three Fujian counties including Taiwan for wind disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 6, bingxu, last year's wind-disaster tax was forgiven in three Fujian counties including Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑甘肅皋蘭等州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, drought relief was given for Gaolan and other Gansu prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Gansu drought districts including Gaolan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚子，布拉呢敦棄喀什噶爾遁。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Burdan abandoned Kashgar and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Burdan fled Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，霍集占棄葉爾羌遁。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Khoja Jahan abandoned Yarkand and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Khoja Jahan fled Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以劉綸為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Liu Lun was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Liu Lun became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以甘肅旱，停發本年巴里坤等處遣犯。

translations.literal: On day wushen, because of Gansu drought, exiles for the year to Barkul and other places were not dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Gansu drought halted this year's exile shipments to Barkul.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉朔，兆惠等奏喀什噶爾、葉爾羌回眾迎降。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, new moon on day jiyou: Zhaohui and others reported that Muslim populations of Kashgar and Yarkand welcomed surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh-month new moon, jiyou, Zhaohui reported Kashgar and Yarkand Muslims submitting.

sentences.zh: 布拉呢敦、霍集占遁巴達克山。

translations.literal: Burdan and Khoja Jahan fled toward Badakhshan.
translations.idiomatic: Burdan and Khoja Jahan escaped to Badakhshan.

sentences.zh: 命阿裏袞等率兵攻巴爾楚克。

translations.literal: Aligun and others were ordered to lead troops against Barchuk.
translations.idiomatic: Aligun was sent to attack Barchuk.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，諭兆惠等追捕布拉呢敦、霍集占。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Zhaohui and others were instructed to pursue Burdan and Khoja Jahan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Zhaohui was ordered to hunt Burdan and Khoja Jahan.

sentences.zh: 命車布登紮布駐伊犁，防霍集占等入俄羅斯。

translations.literal: Chebudengzhab was ordered to garrison Yili lest Khoja Jahan and others enter Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Chebudengzhab was stationed at Yili to block flight into Russia.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以捕蝗不力，奪陳宏謀總督銜。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, because of ineffective locust control, Chen Hongmou was stripped of his governor-general title.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Chen Hongmou lost his governor-general rank for poor locust work.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上奉皇太后啟蹕，秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager in setting out for the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the court left for the Mulan autumn hunt with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 己未，上奉皇太后駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager in halting at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the court halted at the Summer Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 停徵山西陽曲等三十九廳州縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Collection of drought quota tax was suspended for thirty-nine Shanxi prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Yangqu.
translations.idiomatic: Drought quota tax collection was halted in thirty-nine Shanxi districts including Yangqu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改西安總督為川陝總督，四川總督為四川巡撫，甘肅巡撫為甘肅總督管巡撫事。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Xi'an governor-general became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, the Sichuan governor-general became Sichuan governor, and the Gansu governor became Gansu governor-general managing governor affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Xi'an, Sichuan, and Gansu posts were reorganized into Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, Sichuan governor, and Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以開泰為川陝總督，楊應琚為甘肅總督。

translations.literal: Kaitai was made Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general and Yang Yingju Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Kaitai became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general and Yang Yingju Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 山西平定等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts appeared in Pingding and other Shanxi prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck Shanxi districts including Pingding.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，明瑞追剿霍集占等於霍斯庫魯克嶺，大敗之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jimao: Ming Rui pursued and routed Khoja Jahan and others at Khosurkuk Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jimao, Ming Rui heavily defeated Khoja Jahan at Khosurkuk Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賑甘肅皋蘭等四十廳州縣本年旱災。

translations.literal: On day renwu, this year's drought relief was given for forty Gansu prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, forty Gansu districts including Gaolan received drought relief for the year.

sentences.zh: 己丑，申禁英吉利商船逗遛寧波。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the ban on English merchant ships lingering at Ningbo was reiterated.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, lingering English ships at Ningbo were forbidden again.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，富德等奏追剿霍集占于阿勒楚爾，大敗之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Fude and others reported pursuing Khoja Jahan at Altishahr and inflicting a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Fude reported a great victory over Khoja Jahan at Altishahr.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上奉皇太后幸木蘭，行圍。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Mulan for the battue.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the court hunted at Mulan with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 庚子，富德奏兵至葉什勒庫勒諾爾，霍集占竄巴達克山。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Fude reported that the army reached Lake Yashilkul and Khoja Jahan had fled into Badakhshan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Fude reached Yashilkul and reported Khoja Jahan's flight to Badakhshan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，賑浙江江山等縣水災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengxu: flood relief was given for Jiangshan and other Zhejiang counties.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, gengxu, Jiangshan and other Zhejiang counties received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 論剿賊功，晉封回人鄂對為貝子，阿什默特、哈岱默特為公，復敏珠爾多爾濟公爵。

translations.literal: Merits in suppressing the rebels were discussed: the Muslim Odu was advanced to beizi, Ashimet and Hadaimet were made dukes, and Minzhuer Dorji's ducal rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: For pacification service, Odu became beizi, Ashimet and Hadaimet became dukes, and Minzhuer Dorji regained his ducal title.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，定西域祀典。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the sacrificial code for the Western Regions was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Western Region ritual rules were set.

sentences.zh: 命阿桂赴阿克蘇辦事。

translations.literal: Agui was ordered to proceed to Aksu to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Agui was sent to manage affairs at Aksu.

sentences.zh: 晉封玉素布為貝勒。

translations.literal: Yusup was advanced to beile.
translations.idiomatic: Yusup was raised to beile.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，改甘肅安西鎮為安西府。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Gansu's Anxi garrison was changed to Anxi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Anxi garrison became Anxi prefecture.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The court returned to the capital with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 以蘇昌為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Suchang was made Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Suchang became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 除回城霍集占等苛斂。

translations.literal: Excessive levies imposed by Khoja Jahan and others in the Muslim cities were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Oppressive Muslim-city taxes under Khoja Jahan were removed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，頒給阿桂欽差大臣關防。

translations.literal: Tenth month, winter, day jimao: the seal of the imperial commissioner was issued to Agui.
translations.idiomatic: In winter month 10, jimao, Agui received an imperial commissioner seal.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賑山西陽曲等五十六廳州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, drought relief was given for fifty-six Shanxi prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Yangqu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, fifty-six Shanxi drought districts including Yangqu were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜哈甯阿自盡。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Haning'a was granted suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Haning'a was allowed to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禁州縣捕蝗派累民間。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, counties and prefectures were forbidden to burden the people in dispatching locust-catching labor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, locust work must not be shifted onto commoners.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免山西助馬口莊頭本年旱災額賦十分之七。

translations.literal: On day guisi, seventy percent of this year's drought quota tax was remitted for Shanxi zhuangtou at Zhumakou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Shanxi zhuangtou at Zhumakou had seventy percent of drought tax remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以鄂弼為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Ebi was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Ebi became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 賑盛京開原等城、承德等七州縣旱災，撫恤長蘆滄州等六州縣、嚴鎮等五場被水灶戶，均蠲額賦有差。

translations.literal: Drought relief was given for Kaicheng and other Shenyang garrisons and seven Rehe counties including Chengde; salt workers flooded in six Changlu districts including Cangzhou and five saltern fields including Yanzhen were comforted and quota tax remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Shenyang and Rehe drought districts were relieved, Changlu flooded saltern workers were aided, and taxes were remitted by degree.

sentences.zh: 免甘肅狄道等二十二廳州縣上年水災雹災額賦。

translations.literal: Last year's flood and hail quota tax was remitted for twenty-two Gansu prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Didao.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-two Gansu districts including Didao had last year's flood and hail tax forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賑順天直隸固安等四十七州縣廳水霜雹蟲災，並蠲額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, disaster relief was given for water, frost, hail, and insect damage in forty-seven Zhili prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Gu'an, and quota tax was remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, forty-seven Zhili disaster districts including Gu'an were relieved and taxes remitted by degree.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，諭：「國家承平百年，休養滋息，生齒漸繁。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, an edict said: "The state has enjoyed a century of peace; rest and nurture have increased and population has gradually grown.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, an edict opened: the realm has been at peace a hundred years and the people have multiplied.

sentences.zh: 今幸邊陲式廓萬有餘里，以新辟之土疆，佐中原之耕鑿，又化凶頑之敗類為務本之良民，一舉而數善備。

translations.literal: Now fortunately the frontier has been greatly extended for more than ten thousand li; newly opened territory will aid Central Plains farming, and fierce rebels will be turned into law-abiding cultivators—several goods accomplished at once.
translations.idiomatic: New frontiers now aid the heartland, rebels become farmers, and several benefits follow at once.

sentences.zh: 各督撫其通飭所屬，安插巴里坤各城人犯，分別懲治，勿以縱釋有罪為仁，使良法不行。

translations.literal: Governors and governors-general should instruct their subordinates to settle convicts from the Barkul garrisons, punish them appropriately, and not treat releasing the guilty as benevolence so that good law cannot operate."
translations.idiomatic: Governors must settle Barkul convicts, punish fittingly, and not mistake leniency toward criminals for virtue.

sentences.zh: 」己亥，賑江蘇上元等十九州縣廳衛水蟲風潮災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, relief was given for water, insect, wind, and tide disasters in nineteen Jiangsu prefectures, counties, garrisons, and guards including Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, nineteen Jiangsu districts including Shangyuan received flood and pest relief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，富德奏巴達克山素勒坦沙獻霍集占首級，全部投誠。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Fude reported that the Badakhshan ruler Sultan Shah had presented Khoja Jahan's head and the whole region submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Fude reported Sultan Shah of Badakhshan sent Khoja Jahan's head and submitted.

sentences.zh: 命宣諭中外。

translations.literal: Orders were issued to proclaim this at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the news proclaimed within and without.

sentences.zh: 將軍兆惠加賞宗室公品級鞍轡。

translations.literal: General Zhaohui was additionally granted saddle and bridle of princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui received princely-grade saddle gear.

sentences.zh: 將軍富德晉封侯爵，並賞戴雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: General Fude was advanced to marquis and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Fude was raised to marquis and given double peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 參贊大臣公明瑞、公阿裏袞賞戴雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: Campaign assistant grand ministers Duke Ming Rui and Duke Aligun were granted double peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui and Aligun received double peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 舒赫德以下，均從優議敘。

translations.literal: Shuhede and all below were rewarded with preferential commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede and others received preferential merit review.

sentences.zh: 晉封額敏和卓為郡王，賞玉素布郡王品級。

translations.literal: Emin Khoja was advanced to junwang and Yusup was granted junwang rank.
translations.idiomatic: Emin Khoja became junwang and Yusup received junwang status.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以平定準、回兩部用兵本末，制開惑論，宣示中外。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, an essay Clarifying Doubts on the origins of pacifying the Zunghar and Muslim regions was composed and promulgated at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Clarifying Doubts on the Zunghar and Muslim campaigns was issued.

sentences.zh: 賑浙江嘉興等二十州縣衛所、雙穗等九場水災蟲災。

translations.literal: Flood and insect disaster relief was given for twenty Zhejiang prefectures, counties, garrisons, and guards including Jiaxing and nine saltern fields including Shuangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang flood and insect districts and nine saltern fields were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，卻諸王大臣請上尊號。

translations.literal: On day renyin, princes and grand ministers' request for an honorific title was declined.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, requests for an honorific title were refused.

sentences.zh: 賑陝西定邊等九縣旱雹霜災。

translations.literal: Drought, hail, and frost disaster relief was given for nine Shaanxi counties including Dingbian.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Shaanxi counties including Dingbian received drought and hail relief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，召喀爾喀、杜爾伯特諸部落汗、王、公等赴太平嘉宴。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Khalkha and Dörbet tribal khans, princes, and dukes were summoned to the Great Peace felicitation banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Khalkha and Dörbet rulers were invited to the Great Peace banquet.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，以平定回部，上率諸王大臣詣皇太后壽康宮慶賀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai: because the Muslim regions were pacified, the Emperor led princes and grand ministers to congratulate the Empress Dowager at Shoukang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, xinhai, the Emperor led the court to congratulate the Empress Dowager at Shoukang on pacifying the Muslims.

sentences.zh: 禦太和殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: He received congratulatory audience at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: He received court congratulations at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 頒詔中外，覃恩有差。

translations.literal: An edict was promulgated at home and abroad and favor granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts went out and grace was distributed by degree.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，楊應琚加太子太師。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yang Yingju was given the additional title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yang Yingju became Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，除山東濟寧州、魚台縣水淹地賦。

translations.literal: On day yichou, flooded land tax was abolished for Jining prefecture and Yutai county in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Shandong flood land tax was abolished at Jining and Yutai.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命各回城伯克等輪班入覲。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Muslim-city begs and others were ordered to come to audience in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Muslim begs were ordered to audience by turns.

sentences.zh: 哈爾塔金布魯特來降。

translations.literal: Kirghiz of Khartai submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Khartai Kirghiz submitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，賑甘肅皋蘭等十四廳州縣及東樂縣丞屬本年旱災。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: this year's drought relief was given for fourteen Gansu prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Gaolan and the Dongle county assistant magistrate's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiazi, fourteen Gansu drought districts and Dongle were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免兩淮丁溪等七場被災應納折價十分之七。

translations.literal: On day guisi, seventy percent of the commuted price due from seven Two Huai saltern fields including Dingxi was remitted because of disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, seven Two Huai saltern fields had seventy percent of commuted dues remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賑山東海豐等十六州縣衛、永阜等三場本年水災潮災。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, this year's flood and tide disaster relief was given for sixteen Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Haifeng and three saltern fields including Yongfu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, sixteen Shandong districts and three saltern fields received flood and tide relief.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免浙江江山等三縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, this year's flood quota tax was remitted for three Zhejiang counties including Jiangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, three Zhejiang flood counties including Jiangshan had tax remitted.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月戊申，以西師凱旋，再免來歲甘肅額賦。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, day wushen: because the western army returned victorious, next year's Gansu quota tax was again remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 25, wushen, next year's Gansu quota tax was remitted for the western victory.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賑甘肅皋蘭等州縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, drought relief was given for Gaolan and other Gansu prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Gansu drought districts including Gaolan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命烏魯木齊屯田。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, colonization farming was ordered at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Urumqi colonization was ordered.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，霍罕額爾德尼伯克遣使陀克塔瑪特等入覲。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Kokand's ruler Id Khan sent envoys Toktamat and others to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Kokand sent Toktamat and other envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，巴達克山素勒坦沙遣使額莫爾伯克等及齊哩克、博羅爾使入覲。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Badakhshan's Sultan Shah sent envoys E'mo'er Beg and others and envoys of Chitral and Baltistan came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Sultan Shah, Chitral, and Baltistan sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 定邊將軍兆惠等以霍集占首級來上，並俘酋捫多索丕等至京。

translations.literal: Frontier Pacification General Zhaohui and others presented Khoja Jahan's head and brought captive chiefs including Mundosop and others to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui presented Khoja Jahan's head and captive leaders including Mundosop reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上御午門行獻俘禮。

translations.literal: On day dingji, the Emperor presided at the Meridian Gate for the captive-presentation rite.
translations.idiomatic: On dingji day, the Emperor held the captive rite at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 命霍集占首級懸示通衢，宥捫多索丕等罪。

translations.literal: Khoja Jahan's head was ordered displayed at public crossroads; Mundosop and others were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Khoja Jahan's head was hung in the streets and Mundosop and others were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己未，布魯特阿濟比遣使錫喇噶斯等入覲。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Kirghiz Ajib sent envoys Silagasi and others to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Kirghiz Ajib sent Silagasi and others to court.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，命侍郎裘曰修、伊祿順清查甘肅各州縣辦理軍需。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: Vice Ministers Qiu Yuexiu and Yilushun were ordered to audit military supplies handled by Gansu prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dingchou, Qiu Yuexiu and Yilushun audited Gansu military provisioning.

sentences.zh: 賑扎薩克圖汗等四旗部落饑。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given for the four banners of the Jasagtu Khan and other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Four Jasagtu banners received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上啟蹕詣東陵。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor set out for the Eastern Mausolea.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Emperor left for the Eastern Mausolea.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑山西陽曲等州縣上年旱災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, drought relief was given for last year's drought in Yangqu and other Shanxi prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Shanxi districts including Yangqu received last year's drought relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor visited Zhao Mausoleum, Xiao Mausoleum, Xiao East Mausoleum, and Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor visited Zhao, Xiao, Xiao East, and Jing mausolea.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以清馥遷延諱匿，命正法。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, because Qing Fu delayed and concealed reports, he was ordered executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Qing Fu was executed for delay and concealment.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免盛京等十九驛旱災額賦，並賑之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, drought quota tax was remitted for nineteen Shenyang relay stations and relief given.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, nineteen Shenyang stations had drought tax remitted and were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命車布登紮布以副將軍統兵剿捕哈薩克巴魯克巴圖魯，以瑪巘、車木楚克紮布為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Chebudengzhab was made deputy general to lead troops against the Kazakh Baruk Batiru; Ma Yan and Chemuchukezhab were made campaign assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Chebudengzhab was sent against the Kazakh Baruk Batiru with Ma Yan and Chemuchukezhab as assistants.

sentences.zh: 上詣泰陵。

translations.literal: The Emperor went to Tai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor went to Tai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor visited Tai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor visited Tai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 以兆惠、富德為御前大臣。

translations.literal: Zhaohui and Fude were made Grand Ministers in Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaohui and Fude became Grand Ministers in Attendance.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，兆惠等凱旋，上至良鄉郊勞。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Zhaohui and others returned victorious; the Emperor went to Liangxiang to welcome them in the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Zhaohui returned in triumph and the Emperor welcomed him at Liangxiang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜哈密扎薩克郡王品級、貝勒玉素布等冠服有差。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, caps and robes were granted in varying degrees to the Jasak junwang-rank prince of Hami, beile Yusup, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Hami's junwang prince, beile Yusup, and others received graded robes.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午朔，上御太和殿受凱旋朝賀。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day bingwu: the Emperor presided at the Hall of Supreme Harmony and received congratulatory audience on the triumphant return.
translations.idiomatic: On the third-month new moon, bingwu, the Emperor received victory congratulations at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 丁未，試辦伊犁海努克等處屯田。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, trial colonization farming was launched at Hainuk and other places in Yili.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, trial farming began at Hainuk and other Yili sites.

sentences.zh: 設烏魯木齊至羅克倫屯田村莊。

translations.literal: Farming colonies were established in villages from Urumqi to Luokelun.
translations.idiomatic: Colonies were set up along the Urumqi–Luokelun route.

sentences.zh: 免安徽懷寧等十七州縣衛上年水蟲災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land tax for seventeen prefectures, counties, and guards including Huaining in Anhui stricken by flood and insect disaster the previous year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Prior-year flood and insect tax was remitted in seventeen Anhui districts including Huaining.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以阿布都拉為烏什阿奇木伯克，阿什默特為和闐阿奇木伯克，噶岱默特為喀什噶爾阿奇木伯克，鄂對為葉爾羌阿奇木伯克。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Abdulla was made Akchmu beg of Ush, Ashemte Akchmu beg of Khotan, Gadaimute Akchmu beg of Kashgar, and Edui Akchmu beg of Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, four western cities received new Akchmu begs: Abdulla at Ush, Ashemte at Khotan, Gadaimute at Kashgar, and Edui at Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，頒阿桂關防，駐伊犁辦事，常亮等協同辦事。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, A Gui's seal of office was issued; he was stationed at Yili to handle affairs, with Chang Liang and others assisting jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, A Gui received his seal and took charge at Yili with Chang Liang and others.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免浙江仁和等十州縣衛所、雙穗等九場上年水災蟲災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, quota land tax for ten prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Renhe in Zhejiang and nine salt-fields including Shuangsui stricken by flood and insect disaster the previous year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, prior-year flood and insect tax was remitted in ten Zhejiang districts and nine salt-fields.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賑江蘇上元等五十五州縣衛上年水災。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, relief was given for flood disaster the previous year in fifty-five prefectures, counties, and guards including Shangyuan in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Jiangsu flood relief reached fifty-five districts including Shangyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上臨和碩和婉公主喪次，賜奠。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor went in person to the mourning hall of the Hosoi Hewan Princess and bestowed funeral offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor mourned at the Hosoi Hewan Princess's hall and sent offerings.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上幸皇六子永瑢第。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor visited the residence of the sixth prince, Yong Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor called at Prince Yong Huang's mansion.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命新柱往葉爾羌辦事。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Xinzhu was ordered to proceed to Yarkand to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Xinzhu was sent to Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 己巳，晉封純貴妃為皇貴妃。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Pure Noble Consort was advanced to Imperial Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Pure Noble Consort became Imperial Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 以巴圖濟爾噶勒為內大臣。

translations.literal: Batujiergale was made an inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: Batujiergale received appointment as inner minister.

sentences.zh: 庚午，免山東海豐等十六州縣、永阜等三場上年潮水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, quota land tax for sixteen prefectures and counties including Haifeng in Shandong and three salt-fields including Yongfu stricken by tidal disaster the previous year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, prior-year tidal-disaster tax was remitted in sixteen Shandong counties and three salt-fields.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，以山東蘭山等縣蝻生，命直隸豫防之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: because locust nymphs appeared in counties including Lanshan in Shandong, Zhili and Henan were ordered to guard against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, locusts in Shandong prompted preventive orders in Zhili and Henan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，內大臣薩喇勒卒。

translations.literal: On day jihai, inner minister Saral died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, inner minister Saral died.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰朔，日食，詔修省。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiachen, new moon: there was a solar eclipse; an edict ordered sincere self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth-month new moon on jiachen, an eclipse edict called for self-reform.

sentences.zh: 丙午，諭陝甘總督轄境止烏魯木齊，飭楊應琚仍回內地。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, it was announced that the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general's jurisdiction would extend only to Urumqi, and Yang Yingju was ordered to return to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the northwest command was narrowed to Urumqi and Yang Yingju was recalled inland.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔曰：「內地民人往蒙古四十八部種植，設禁之，是厲民。

translations.literal: On day renzi, an edict said: "When people from the interior go to plant in the forty-eight Mongol banners, forbidding it would harm the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, an edict argued that banning interior settlers from farming in the forty-eight Mongol banners would only hurt the people.

sentences.zh: 今烏魯木齊各處屯政方興，客民前往，各成聚落，汙萊辟而就食多，大裨國家牧民本圖。

translations.literal: Now colonization at Urumqi and elsewhere is flourishing; guests go there and form settlements, opening wasteland and gaining much livelihood—greatly aiding the state's fundamental policy of shepherding the people.
translations.idiomatic: It praised thriving Xinjiang colonies and migrant villages that opened wasteland in line with the state's pastoral policy.

sentences.zh: 無識者又疑勞民。

translations.literal: The ignorant again suspect it burdens the people.
translations.idiomatic: The edict dismissed fears that colonization overburdened the people.

sentences.zh: 特為宣諭。

translations.literal: This is specially proclaimed for instruction.
translations.idiomatic: The clarification was issued expressly.

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，賜畢沅等一百六十四人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day guichou, one hundred sixty-four metropolitan graduates including Bi Yuan were granted jinshi degrees and origin ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Bi Yuan and 163 others received jinshi degrees with graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免安徽懷寧等十七州縣衛上年水災蟲傷額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, quota land tax for seventeen prefectures, counties, and guards including Huaining in Anhui stricken by flood and insect damage the previous year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, prior-year flood and insect tax was remitted again in seventeen Anhui districts.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，裁陝西榆葭道，改延綏道為延榆綏道，移駐榆林府，以鄜州隸督糧道。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Shaanxi Yujia circuit was abolished; the Yan-Sui circuit was renamed the Yan-Yu-Sui circuit and moved to station at Yulin prefecture, with Bozhou placed under the grain transport circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, northwest circuits were reorganized: Yujia was abolished and Yan-Yu-Sui moved to Yulin.

sentences.zh: 己巳，哈薩克阿布勒巴木比特遣使入覲，賜敕書，卻所請遊牧伊犁，及居住巴爾魯克等地。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Abulbambit of the Kazakhs sent envoys to audience; an imperial letter was bestowed, and requests to graze at Yili and to dwell at places including Barkul were declined.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, a Kazakh envoy was received, but grazing and settlement requests at Yili and Barkul were refused.

sentences.zh: 前掠烏梁海之巴魯克巴圖魯服罪，獻還所獲，仍錫賚之。

translations.literal: The Barkul Baturu who had earlier raided Urianghai submitted in guilt, returned what had been taken, and was still rewarded with gifts.
translations.idiomatic: A repentant Barkul raider restored his loot and still received imperial gifts.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，免甘肅徵本年及來年耗羨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: the surtax levied in Gansu for the current and coming years was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Gansu surtax for this year and next was waived.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，召阿裏袞回京。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Aligun was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Aligun was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命海明赴喀什噶爾辦事。

translations.literal: Haiming was ordered to proceed to Kashgar to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Haiming was sent to Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯朔，諭熱河捕蝗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guimao, new moon: locust-catching was ordered in Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: At the seventh-month new moon, Rehe was ordered to catch locusts.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，山西寧遠等廳、直隸廣昌等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, locusts appeared in departments including Ningyuan in Shanxi and in prefectures and counties including Guangchang in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, locusts struck Shanxi and Zhili districts including Ningyuan and Guangchang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，伯什克勒木等莊回人邁喇木呢雅斯叛，阿裏袞剿平之。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Hui of villages including Beshiklem rebelled; Aligun suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Aligun crushed a Hui rebellion in the Beshiklem villages.

sentences.zh: 以阿思哈為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Asiha was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Asiha became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賑江蘇高郵等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yimao, relief was given for flood disaster in prefectures and counties including Gaoyou in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Jiangsu flood relief reached districts including Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以楊寧為喀什噶爾提督。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Yang Ning was made military commander at Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Yang Ning became Kashgar commander.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以俄羅斯駐兵和寧嶺、喀屯河、額爾齊斯、阿勒坦諾爾四路，聲言分界，諭阿桂、車布登紮布等來歲以兵逐之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, because Russia had stationed troops on four routes—Hening Ridge, the Khatun River, the Irtysh, and Altan Nor—and proclaimed boundary demarcation, A Gui, Chebudengzhabu, and others were instructed to drive them out with troops the following year.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Russian border troops prompted orders for A Gui and others to expel them next year.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，命烏魯木齊駐劄大臣安泰、定長、永德為總辦，列名奏事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: Antai, Dingchang, and Yongde, ministers stationed at Urumqi, were made general coordinators and listed by name in memorials to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Urumqi ministers Antai, Dingchang, and Yongde became chief coordinators with direct memorial rights.

sentences.zh: 其大臣侍衛等，均如領隊大臣例，專任一事，咨安泰等轉奏。

translations.literal: Their minister-bodyguards and the like were all, like brigade ministers, each charged with one matter and were to report through Antai and the others for transmission.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate ministers handled single portfolios and reported through the coordinators.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the court opened the autumn hunt at Mulan with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以阿桂總理伊犁事務，授為都統。

translations.literal: On day renchen, A Gui was put in overall charge of Yili affairs and appointed commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, A Gui became Yili commander-in-chief with overall authority.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上奉皇太后駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the court stayed at the Summer Mountain Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上奉皇太后幸木蘭，行圍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, went to Mulan for the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Empress Dowager accompanied the Emperor to the Mulan hunt.

sentences.zh: 己亥，增設江蘇江寧布政使，駐江寧府，分轄江、淮、揚、徐、通、海六府州。

translations.literal: On day jihai, a Jiangning provincial treasurer was added, stationed at Jiangning prefecture, with jurisdiction over six prefectures: Jiang, Huai, Yang, Xu, Tong, and Hai.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, a Jiangning treasurer was created for six Huai-Yang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 以蘇州布政使分轄蘇、松、常、鎮、太五府州，安徽布政使回駐安慶。

translations.literal: The Suzhou provincial treasurer was to govern five prefectures—Su, Song, Chang, Zhen, and Tai—and the Anhui treasurer returned to station at Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou took five prefectures; the Anhui treasurer returned to Anqing.

sentences.zh: 命讬庸調補江寧布政使。

translations.literal: Tuo Yong was ordered to fill the Jiangning provincial treasurer post.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Yong was appointed Jiangning treasurer.

sentences.zh: 命戶部侍郎于敏中在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: Yu Minzhong, Vice Minister of Revenue, was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong joined the Grand Council while retaining his ministry post.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，喀爾喀車臣汗劄薩克旺沁紮布，以不能約束屬人，革劄薩克，降貝子為鎮國公。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yimao: Zhasak Wangqinjab of the Khalkha Tsetsen Khan, for being unable to restrain his subjects, was stripped of zhasak rank and demoted from beile to defender duke of the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, a Khalkha zhasak was demoted for failing to control his people.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，恆祿引見，以舒明署綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Henglu was presented at audience; Shuming acted as Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Henglu had audience while Shuming acted at Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，三姓副都統巴岱以挖葠人眾滋事，不能捕治，反給牌票，上以畏懦責之，命正法。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Bade, vice commander at Sansing, because ginseng diggers caused trouble and he could not capture and punish them but instead issued tally-slips, was rebuked by the Emperor as cowardly and ordered executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Bade was executed for cowardice after ginseng riots at Sansing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命德爾格駐辟展辦事。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Delige was ordered to station at Pizhan to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Delige was sent to Pizhan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，哈薩克汗阿布賚使都勒特克埒入覲。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Dutletkelie, envoy of Kazakh Khan Abuzhay, came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, a Kazakh khan's envoy had audience.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申朔，上奉皇太后回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renshen, new moon: the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to halt at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: At the tenth-month new moon, the court returned to the Summer Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以蘇州布政使蘇崇阿刑求書吏，妄奏侵蝕七十餘萬，劉統勳等鞫治皆虛，革發伊犁。

translations.literal: On day yihai, because Suzhou provincial treasurer Su Chong'a had tortured clerks and falsely memorialized embezzlement of more than seven hundred thousand, Liu Tongxun and others investigated and found it all false; he was dismissed and banished to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Su Chong'a was exiled to Yili after a false embezzlement case collapsed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以恆祿為吉林將軍，如松為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Henglu was made Jilin general and Rusong Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Henglu went to Jilin and Rusong to Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑安徽宿州等十三州縣衛本年水災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, relief was given for flood disaster in the current year in thirteen prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Anhui flood relief reached thirteen districts including Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the court returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 以阿裏袞為領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Aligun was made chief attendant inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: Aligun became chief attendant inner minister.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，免直隸宣化等七州縣本年水雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guisi, quota land tax for seven prefectures and counties including Xuanhua in Zhili stricken by flood and hail in the current year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Zhili flood and hail tax was remitted in seven districts including Xuanhua.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑湖南常寧等十二州縣衛旱災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, relief was given for drought disaster in twelve prefectures, counties, and guards including Changning in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Hunan drought relief reached twelve districts including Changning.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，免江蘇山陽等二十五州縣衛本年水災額賦有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao: quota land tax for twenty-five prefectures, counties, and guards including Shanyang in Jiangsu stricken by flood in the current year was remitted in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, graded flood tax relief was granted in twenty-five Jiangsu districts including Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，除山東永利等二場並海豐縣潮沖灶地額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, quota land tax for two salt-fields including Yongli and tidal-washed saltern land in Haifeng county, Shandong, was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Shandong abolished tax on ruined salterns at Yongli and Haifeng.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賑甘肅洮州等二十七廳州縣衛本年水災。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, relief was given for flood disaster in the current year in twenty-seven departments, prefectures, counties, and guards including Taozhou in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Gansu flood relief reached twenty-seven districts including Taozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以常鈞署江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Chang Jun acted as Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Chang Jun acted Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，允墾肅州鄰邊荒地，開渠溉田。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, reclamation of wasteland on the Jiuquan border was permitted and canals were opened to irrigate fields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Jiuquan border wasteland was opened to irrigation.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，西安將軍松阿哩以受屬員餽遺，褫職論絞。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu: Song Ali, general at Xi'an, for accepting gifts from subordinates, was stripped of office and sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Xi'an general Song Ali was condemned to death for taking bribes.

sentences.zh: 命甘肅總督仍改為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: The Gansu governor-general was again renamed Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest post was restored to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以伊犁、葉爾羌等處均駐大臣，無須更置道員，歸總督轄。

translations.literal: Because ministers were stationed at Yili, Yarkand, and other places, there was no need to add circuit intendants; affairs were placed under the governor-general's jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Western garrison ministers made new circuit posts unnecessary; the governor-general took charge.

sentences.zh: 停四川總督兼管陝西。

translations.literal: The Sichuan governor-general ceased concurrent charge of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan no longer concurrently governed Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 調胡寶瑔為江西巡撫，吳達善為河南巡撫，以明德為甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: Hu Baoyu was transferred to Jiangxi governor, Wu Dashan to Henan governor, and Mingde to Gansu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Baoyu, Wu Dashan, and Mingde received new governorships in Jiangxi, Henan, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大學士蔣溥以病乞休，溫諭慰留。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Grand Secretary Jiang Pu asked to retire on grounds of illness; a warm edict urged him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Jiang Pu's retirement plea was gently refused.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上幸瀛台，賜入覲葉爾羌諸城伯克薩里等食，至重華宮賜茶果。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor went to Yingtai, bestowed food on begs from Yarkand and other cities who had come to audience, including Sali, and at the Chonghua Palace bestowed tea and fruit.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Emperor entertained Yarkand begs at Yingtai and Chonghua Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，阿思哈論絞。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Asiha was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the same renchen day, Asiha was condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 丙申，德敏遷荊州將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Demin was transferred to Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Demin became Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 以永貴為左都御史，命赴喀什噶爾辦事，代舒赫德回京。

translations.literal: Yonggui was made Left Censor-in-chief and ordered to proceed to Kashgar to handle affairs, replacing Shuhede on his return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yonggui became Left Censor and went to Kashgar as Shuhede returned.

sentences.zh: 是年，朝鮮、南掌入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Nanzhan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Nanzhan sent tribute that year.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月壬寅，紫光閣落成，賜畫像功臣並文武大臣，蒙古王公等宴。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, spring, first month, day renyin: the Hall of Purple Glazed Light was completed; portraits of meritorious ministers, civil and military officials, and Mongol princes and nobles were bestowed, and a banquet was given.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 26, the Ziguang Pavilion was finished and meritorious officials were feasted.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南零陵等七州縣、江蘇清河等六州縣水災。

translations.literal: Relief was given for flood disaster in seven prefectures and counties including Lingling in Hunan and six prefectures and counties including Qinghe in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Flood relief went to seven Hunan and six Jiangsu districts.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以愛必達、劉藻兩年所出屬員考語相同，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, because Ai Bida and Liu Zao had submitted identical evaluations of subordinates for two years, the ministry was ordered to deliberate severely.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Ai Bida and Liu Zao faced severe review for duplicate personnel reports.

sentences.zh: 浙江提督馬龍圖以挪用公項，解任鞫治。

translations.literal: Ma Longtu, Zhejiang military commander, for misappropriating public funds, was removed from office and prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang commander Ma Longtu was dismissed and tried for embezzlement.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，尹繼善陛見，高晉護兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Yin Jishan had audience at court; Gao Jin acted as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Yin Jishan had audience while Gao Jin acted at Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 調海明赴阿克蘇辦事。

translations.literal: Haiming was transferred to proceed to Aksu to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Haiming was sent to Aksu.

sentences.zh: 命舒赫德赴喀什噶爾辦事，永貴赴葉爾羌辦事。

translations.literal: Shuhede was ordered to proceed to Kashgar to handle affairs, and Yonggui to Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede went to Kashgar and Yonggui to Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以傅森署左都御史。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Fu Sen acted as Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Fu Sen acted Left Censor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上臨大學士蔣溥第視疾。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor went in person to Grand Secretary Jiang Pu's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Emperor visited the sick Jiang Pu.

sentences.zh: 鄂寶以回護陸川縣縱賊一案，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: E Bao, for shielding the Luchuan county magistrate in a case of condoning bandits, was ordered to the ministry for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: E Bao faced severe review for protecting a magistrate who tolerated bandits.

sentences.zh: 以讬庸為廣西巡撫，永泰署湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Tuo Yong was made Guangxi governor, and Yongtai acted as Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Yong went to Guangxi; Yongtai acted in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上奉皇太后西巡五台。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, toured west to Mount Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the court began the Wutai pilgrimage with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免所過州縣額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day renwu, three-tenths of quota land tax in prefectures and counties along the route was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, thirty percent of route taxes was waived.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上奉皇太后謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, paid respects at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the court visited Tailing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，安南國王黎維禕卒，封其侄黎維為安南國王。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, King Li Weiyi of Annan died; his nephew Li Wei was enfeoffed king of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Annan's king died and his nephew succeeded.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免直隸宣化、萬全等八州縣乾隆八年至十八年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, arrears of quota land tax from the eighth to eighteenth years of Qianlong in eight prefectures and counties including Xuanhua and Wanchuan in Zhili were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Zhili back taxes from Qianlong 8–18 were forgiven in eight districts.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上奉皇太后駐台麓寺。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, halted at Tailu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the pilgrimage halted at Tailu Temple.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免山東濟寧等三州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jihai, quota land tax for three prefectures and counties including Jining in Shandong stricken by flood the previous year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, prior-year flood tax was remitted in three Shandong districts including Jining.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅淵泉等三縣農民豌豆籽種，令試種。

translations.literal: Pea seed was loaned to farmers in three counties including Yuanquan in Gansu for trial planting.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu farmers in three counties received pea seed loans for trial crops.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，希布察克布魯特額莫爾比自安集延來歸，遣使入覲。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: Ermerbi of the Khirgiz Shibochak, coming from Andijan to submit, sent envoys to audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, a Khirgiz defector from Andijan sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上幸正定府閱兵。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor went to Zhengding prefecture to review troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor reviewed troops at Zhengding.

sentences.zh: 戊申，江南河道總督白鍾山卒，以高晉代之。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Bai Zhongshan, director-general of the Jiangnan waterways, died; Gao Jin replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, waterways chief Bai Zhongshan died and Gao Jin succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 調讬庸為安徽巡撫，以熊學鵬為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Tuo Yong was transferred to Anhui governor, and Xiong Xuepeng to Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Yong went to Anhui; Xiong Xuepeng to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 己酉，設喀什噶爾駐劄辦事大臣，命伊勒圖協同永貴辦事。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, a resident minister to handle affairs was established at Kashgar; Yiletubu was ordered to assist Yonggui jointly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Kashgar gained a resident minister with Yiletubu assisting Yonggui.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賑安徽宿州等十三州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, relief was given for flood disaster in thirteen prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Anhui flood relief reached thirteen districts including Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上幸平陽澱行圍。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor went to Pingyang Marsh for the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the Emperor hunted at Pingyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免直隸宣化等二縣上年雹災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yimao, quota land tax was remitted for Xuanhua and two other counties in Zhili on account of hail disaster the previous year.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, prior-year hail tax was remitted in two Zhili counties including Xuanhua.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，授阿桂內大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, A Gui was appointed an inner grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, A Gui became an inner grand minister.

sentences.zh: 改綏遠城建威將軍曰綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: The Jianwei General at Suiyuan City was retitled General of Suiyuan City.
translations.idiomatic: The Suiyuan City Jianwei General was renamed General of Suiyuan City.

sentences.zh: 己巳，南掌國王蘇嗎喇薩提拉准第駕公滿遣使表賀皇太后聖壽、皇上萬壽，並貢方物。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the king of Lan Xang, Sumalasa, and the Queen Regent sent envoys congratulating the Empress Dowager on her birthday and the Emperor on his longevity, presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Lan Xang sent birthday tribute for the Empress Dowager and Emperor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，上臨莊親王第、大學士蔣溥第視疾。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengwu: the Emperor visited the Prince of Zhuang and Grand Secretary Jiang Pu to inquire after their illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on gengwu day, the Emperor called on the Prince of Zhuang and Jiang Pu.

sentences.zh: 辛未，莊有恭奏劾參將安廷召，不以保舉在前，姑容于後，諭嘉之。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Zhuang Yougong impeached Brigadier An Tingzhao for tolerating misconduct after earlier recommending him; an edict praised Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Zhuang Yougong was commended for impeaching An Tingzhao.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大學士蔣溥卒。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Grand Secretary Jiang Pu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Grand Secretary Jiang Pu died.

sentences.zh: 命旌額理、阿思哈赴烏魯木齊辦事，達桑阿赴阿克蘇辦事，代安泰、定長、納世通回京。

translations.literal: Jing'eli and Asiha were ordered to take charge at Urumqi and Dasang'a at Aksu, replacing An Tai, Dingchang, and Nashitong returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jing'eli and Asiha went to Urumqi and Aksu; An Tai, Dingchang, and Nashitong returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免湖南常寧等十二州縣上年旱災額賦有差。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, graded remissions of quota land tax were granted for twelve prefectures and counties including Changning in Hunan on account of last year's drought.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, graded drought tax relief reached twelve Hunan districts including Changning.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Vanguard Corps.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Corps troops.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以李侍堯為戶部尚書，調蘇昌為兩廣總督，愛必達為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Li Shiyao was made Minister of Revenue; Su Chang was transferred to Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general; Aibida to Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Li Shiyao, Su Chang, and Aibida received high appointments.

sentences.zh: 以吳達善為雲貴總督，常鈞為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Wu Dahan was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Chang Jun Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dahan became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Chang Jun became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命劉藻暫署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Liu Zao was ordered to act as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Liu Zao was ordered to act as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜王傑等二百一十七人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Wang Jie and 217 others were granted metropolitan graduate degrees with distinctions of rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Wang Jie and 217 others received metropolitan degrees.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，以劉統勳為東閣大學士，兼管禮部事，梁詩正為吏部尚書、協辦大學士，劉綸為兵部尚書，金德瑛為左都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingwei: Liu Tongxun was made Eastern Pavilion Grand Secretary and concurrently supervised the Board of Rites; Liang Shizheng became Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary; Liu Lun Minister of War; Jin Deying Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Liu Tongxun, Liang Shizheng, Liu Lun, and Jin Deying received major posts.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以定長為福建巡撫，楊廷璋兼署之。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Dingchang was made Fujian governor with Yang Tingzhang acting for him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Dingchang became Fujian governor with Yang Tingzhang acting.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，賑雲南新興等二州縣地震災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiwei: relief was given for earthquake disaster in Xinxing and another prefecture in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, earthquake relief reached two Yunnan districts including Xinxing.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免江蘇句容等十八州縣衛坍地額賦。

translations.literal: On day renchen, quota land tax was remitted for collapsed fields in eighteen prefectures, counties, and guards including Jurong in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, collapsed-field tax was remitted in eighteen Jiangsu districts including Jurong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，協辦大學士鄂彌達卒，命兆惠協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinchou: Associate Grand Secretary E'ermida died; Zhaohui was ordered to serve as Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, E'ermida died and Zhaohui was ordered to replace him.

sentences.zh: 調舒赫德為刑部尚書，兆惠署。

translations.literal: Su Hede was transferred to Minister of Punishments with Zhaohui acting.
translations.idiomatic: Su Hede became Minister of Punishments with Zhaohui acting.

sentences.zh: 以阿桂為工部尚書，阿裏袞署。

translations.literal: A Gui was made Minister of Works with Aligun acting.
translations.idiomatic: A Gui became Minister of Works with Aligun acting.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上啟蹕，秋獮大蘭。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor set out on the autumn hunt at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor began the autumn hunt at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 命諴親王允祕扈皇太后駕。

translations.literal: Prince Cheng Yunmi was ordered to escort the Empress Dowager.
