translations.idiomatic: Prince Cheng Yunmi was ordered to escort the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor halted at the Summer Mountain Resort.

sentences.zh: 以皇太后巡幸木蘭，直隸沿途地方文武玩忽規避，飭下部嚴議。

translations.literal: Because the Empress Dowager toured Mulan, civil and military officials along the route in Zhili had been negligent and evasive; the ministry was ordered to review them severely.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili route officials were severely reviewed for neglect during the Empress Dowager's Mulan tour.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，河南祥符等州縣河溢。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, rivers overflowed in Xiangfu and other prefectures and counties in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, rivers overflowed in Xiangfu and other Henan districts.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，賑湖北漢川等十三州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: flood relief was distributed in thirteen prefectures, counties, and guards including Hanchuan in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, flood relief reached thirteen Hubei districts including Hanchuan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以湯聘為湖北巡撫，胡寶瑔為河南巡撫，常鈞為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Tang Pin was made Hubei governor, Hu Baojun Henan governor, and Chang Jun Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Tang Pin, Hu Baojun, and Chang Jun became provincial governors.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命高晉赴河南協辦河工。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Gao Jin was ordered to Henan to assist on river works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Gao Jin was sent to assist Henan river works.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上奉皇太后幸木蘭。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, went to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Mulan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，察噶爾、薩爾巴噶什兩部伯克之兄子孟克及雅木古爾齊入覲。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Mengke, nephew of the begs of the Chagar and Sarbaghash tribes, and Yamuguerqi were received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Mengke and Yamuguerqi were received in audience.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，停今年勾決。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou: this year's executions after autumn assizes were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, autumn assize executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命明瑞赴伊犁辦事，代阿桂回京。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Mingrui was ordered to take charge at Ili, replacing A Gui returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Mingrui went to Ili and A Gui returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，山東曹縣二十堡黃河及運河各漫口均合龍。

translations.literal: On day guimao, twenty Yellow River breaches at Cao county in Shandong and various canal breaches were all closed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Yellow River and canal breaches in Shandong were all closed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賑湖南武陵等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, flood relief was distributed in Wuling and other prefectures and counties in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, flood relief reached Hunan districts including Wuling.

sentences.zh: 戊申，河南懷慶府丹、沁二河溢入城，沖沒人口千三百有奇，賑被災人民。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Dan and Qin rivers of Huaiqing prefecture in Henan overflowed into the city, drowning more than 1,300 people; disaster victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Henan river floods drowned over 1,300 people; victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賑湖北沔陽等十一州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day renzi, flood relief was distributed in Mianyang and ten other prefectures, counties, and guards in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, flood relief reached eleven Hubei districts including Mianyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以竇光鼐於會讞大典，紛呶謾詈，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Dou Guangnai was referred for severe punishment for clamoring and reviling at the joint sentencing ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Dou Guangnai was severely punished for disorder at sentencing.

sentences.zh: 己未，命素誠赴烏什辦事，代永慶回京。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Sucheng was ordered to take charge at Uqturpan, replacing Yongqing returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Sucheng went to Uqturpan and Yongqing returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以劄拉豐阿為烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣，雅郎阿赴科布多辦事，代劄隆阿、福祿回京。

translations.literal: Zhalafeng'a was made Grand Councilor at Uliastai; Yalang'a was sent to Kobdo, replacing Zhalong'a and Fulu returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalafeng'a went to Uliastai and Yalang'a to Kobdo; Zhalong'a and Fulu returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命傅景赴西藏辦事，代集福回京。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Fu Jing was ordered to take charge in Tibet, replacing Jifu returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Fu Jing went to Tibet and Jifu returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賑山東濟河等四十五州縣水災，河南祥符等五十四州縣本年水災。

translations.literal: On day yichou, flood relief was distributed in forty-five Shandong prefectures and counties along the Ji River and fifty-four Henan prefectures and counties including Xiangfu for this year's floods.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, flood relief reached forty-five Shandong and fifty-four Henan districts.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，除甘肅皋蘭等三十二廳州縣水沖田畝額賦，並免山丹等五縣水沖撥運糧米。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: quota land tax was cancelled for water-damaged fields in thirty-two departments, prefectures, and counties including Gaolan in Gansu, and transport-grain levies were remitted in five counties including Shandan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Gansu water-damage tax and Shandan transport levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the court returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，召裘曰修回京。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Qiu Yuexiu was summoned back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Qiu Yuexiu was summoned back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 賑江蘇銅山等縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was distributed in Tongshan and other counties in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu flood relief reached Tongshan and other counties.

sentences.zh: 周人驥奏仁懷等處試織繭，各屬仿行，上嘉之。

translations.literal: Zhou Renji memorialized on trial sericulture in Renhuai and elsewhere, urging other districts to follow; the Emperor commended it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Renji was commended for urging trial sericulture in Renhuai and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未朔，賑順直固安等六十九州縣本年水災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day yimao: flood relief was distributed in sixty-nine Zhili prefectures and counties including Gu'an for this year's floods.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's first day, flood relief reached sixty-nine Zhili districts including Gu'an.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以英廉為總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Yinglian was made Director-General of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Yinglian became Director-General of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 己亥，河南楊橋漫口合龍。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Yangqiao breach in Henan was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Yangqiao breach in Henan was closed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，調嵩椿為察哈爾都統，以舒明為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Songchun was transferred to commandant of Chahar and Shu Ming made General of Suiyuan City.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Songchun and Shu Ming received frontier commands.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，免山西陽曲等三十八州縣、大同管糧等十四廳二十四年水災隨徵耗銀。

translations.literal: On day guimao, surtax silver levied with the grain tax was remitted for thirty-eight Shanxi prefectures and counties including Yangqu and fourteen departments of Datong grain administration for the twenty-fourth year's flood.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, twenty-fourth-year flood surtax was remitted in fifty-two Shanxi districts.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免河南祥符等四十三州縣漕糧漕項有差。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, graded remissions of canal grain and related dues were granted for forty-three Henan prefectures and counties including Xiangfu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, graded canal-tax relief reached forty-three Henan districts including Xiangfu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，減江蘇山陽等二十一州縣衛水沈地畝，並除民屯、學田、湖蕩、草灘額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, flooded fields were reduced for assessment in twenty-one Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Shanyang, and quota levies on civilian colonies, school lands, lake flats, and marsh pastures were cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Jiangsu flooded fields and colony levies were adjusted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，禮部尚書五齡安以讀表錯誤，褫職。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Minister of Rites Wuling'an was stripped of office for misreading the memorial at court.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Wuling'an was dismissed for misreading the memorial.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上奉皇太后禦慈甯宮，加上徽號曰崇慶慈宣康惠敦和裕壽純禧恭懿皇太后，翌日頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, attended her at Cining Palace and added the honorific title "Reverent, Celebratory, Kind, Proclaiming, Healthy, Favorable, Harmonious, Abundant, Pure, Auspicious, Respectful, and Gracious Empress Dowager"; the next day an edict granted general grace with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Empress Dowager received a new honorific at Cining Palace; general grace followed.

sentences.zh: 以永貴為禮部尚書，阿裏袞署之。

translations.literal: Yonggui was made Minister of Rites with Aligun acting.
translations.idiomatic: Yonggui became Minister of Rites with Aligun acting.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上奉皇太后禦慈甯宮，率王大臣行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager at Cining Palace, led princes and ministers in congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the court congratulated the Empress Dowager at Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 進制聖母七旬萬壽連珠，奉皇太后懿旨，停止進獻。

translations.literal: A linked-verse ode for the Holy Mother's seventieth birthday was presented; by the Empress Dowager's order further offerings were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: A birthday linked verse was presented, but further offerings were stopped by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 以勒爾森為左都御史。

translations.literal: Le'ersen was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Le'ersen became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，以雲南江川等二州縣地震成災，命加倍賑之，仍免本年額賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingmao: because Jiangchuan and another prefecture in Yunnan suffered earthquake disaster, double relief was ordered and this year's quota tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, double earthquake relief and tax remission were granted in two Yunnan districts.

sentences.zh: 辛未，免江蘇南匯等六州縣二十三年水旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, quota land tax was remitted for six Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Nanhui for the twenty-third year's flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, twenty-third-year disaster tax was remitted in six Jiangsu districts including Nanhui.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑山西文水等十三州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, flood relief was distributed in thirteen Shanxi prefectures and counties including Wenshui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, flood relief reached thirteen Shanxi districts including Wenshui.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賑湖北漢川等二縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, flood relief was distributed in two counties and guards including Hanchuan in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, flood relief reached two Hubei districts including Hanchuan.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月丙申，以奉皇太后巡省江、浙，詔免江蘇、安徽、浙江逋賦。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, day bingshen: because the Empress Dowager toured Jiangsu and Zhejiang, an edict remitted arrears in Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 27, tax arrears were remitted in Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang for the southern tour.

sentences.zh: 賑河南祥符等州縣災民有差。

translations.literal: Relief was given with distinctions to disaster victims in Xiangfu and other Henan prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Graded relief reached disaster victims in Xiangfu and other Henan districts.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以科爾沁敏珠爾多爾濟旗災，貸倉穀濟之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, state grain was lent to the Mongol banner of Khorchin Minzhu'er Dorji.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, state grain was lent to the Khorchin banner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上奉皇太后南巡，發京師，免直隸、山東經過地方本年錢糧十分之三，上年被災處十分之五。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager on a southern tour, set out from the capital; thirty percent of this year's taxes were remitted along the route in Zhili and Shandong, and fifty percent where disaster had struck the previous year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the southern tour began with graded tax remissions along the route.

sentences.zh: 戊申，左都御史金德瑛卒，以董邦達代之。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Left Censor-in-Chief Jin Deying died; Dong Bangda replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Jin Deying died and Dong Bangda replaced him.

sentences.zh: 賑順直文安等二十八州縣上年水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was distributed in twenty-eight Zhili prefectures and counties including Wen'an for the previous year's flood.
translations.idiomatic: Prior-year flood relief reached twenty-eight Zhili districts including Wen'an.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賑山東曹、齊河等二縣水災有差。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, graded flood relief was given in Cao and Qihe counties in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, graded flood relief reached Cao and Qihe in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 召多爾濟回京，命容保駐西寧辦事。

translations.literal: Duorji was summoned to the capital and Rongbao was ordered to take charge at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Duorji was recalled to Beijing and Rongbao was sent to Xining.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，綏遠城將軍舒明卒，調蘊著代之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, General of Suiyuan City Shu Ming died; Yunzhu was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Shu Ming died and Yunzhu replaced him at Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，免山東惠民等十五州縣衛歷年民欠穀銀。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, grain-tax arrears were remitted for fifteen Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Huimin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, grain-tax arrears were remitted in fifteen Shandong districts including Huimin.

sentences.zh: 己未，以周人驥固執開南明河，荒農累民，罷之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Zhou Renji was dismissed for stubbornly opening the Nanming River in Henan, wasting farmland and burdening the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Zhou Renji was dismissed for opening the Nanming River against advice.

sentences.zh: 命喬光烈為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Qiao Guanglie was appointed Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Guanglie became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命清查俄羅斯疆界。

translations.literal: On day guihai, a survey of the Russian border was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Russian border was ordered surveyed.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，賑江蘇高郵等十一州縣、安徽太和等五州縣水災。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi: flood relief was distributed in eleven Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Gaoyou and five Anhui prefectures and counties including Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, flood relief reached eleven Jiangsu and five Anhui districts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命尹繼善為御前大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Yin Jishan was made an imperial chamberlain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Yin Jishan became an imperial chamberlain.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上奉皇太后渡河，閱清口東壩、惠濟閘。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, crossed the river and inspected the eastern dam at Qingkou and the Huiji Lock.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the court inspected Qingkou and the Huiji Lock.

sentences.zh: 命阿裏袞為御前大臣，高晉為內大臣。

translations.literal: Aligun was made an imperial chamberlain and Gao Jin an inner grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: Aligun became an imperial chamberlain and Gao Jin an inner grand minister.

sentences.zh: 丙子，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，哈薩克使策伯克等入覲行在，賜冠服有差。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Kazakh envoys including Tsebek were received in audience at the traveling palace and granted robes with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Kazakh envoys were received and granted robes.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上奉皇太后渡江，閱京口兵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, crossed the Yangzi and reviewed troops at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the court crossed the Yangzi and reviewed troops at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上幸焦山。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor visited Jiaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor visited Jiaoshan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上奉皇太后臨幸蘇州府。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, visited Suzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the court visited Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，免河南祥符等四十三州縣上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, quota land tax was remitted for forty-three Henan prefectures and counties including Xiangfu for last year's flood.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, prior-year flood tax was remitted in forty-three Henan districts including Xiangfu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上謁文廟。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor visited the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor visited the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午朔，上奉皇太后臨幸杭州府。

translations.literal: Third month, first day jiawu: the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, visited Hangzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's first day, the court visited Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上幸海寧閱海塘。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor visited Haining to inspect the seawall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor inspected the Haining seawall.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑湖北潛江等九州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, flood relief was distributed in nine Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Qianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, flood relief reached nine Hubei districts including Qianjiang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上閱兵。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor reviewed troops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor reviewed troops.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免江、浙節年未完地丁屯餉、漕項，並水鄉灶課銀。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, unfinished land-tax, garrison grain, and canal dues in Jiangsu and Zhejiang were remitted, as were salt-field levies in water districts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Jiangsu and Zhejiang taxes and salt levies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賑山東齊河等五州縣上年水災。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, flood relief was given for last year's flood in five Shandong prefectures and counties including Qihe.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, prior-year flood relief reached five Shandong districts including Qihe.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上幸觀潮樓。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor visited the Tide-Watching Tower.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor visited the Tide-Watching Tower.

sentences.zh: 賜浙江召試貢生沈初等二人舉人，與進士孫士毅等二人並授內閣中書。

translations.literal: Two Zhejiang tribute students summoned for examination, Shen Chu and another, were granted provincial graduate rank; together with two metropolitan graduates, Sun Shiyi and another, all four were appointed Secretariat draftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Chu and three others were appointed Secretariat draftsmen.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上奉皇太后臨視織造機房。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, visited the imperial weaving workshops.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the court visited the imperial weaving workshops.

sentences.zh: 丙午，回蹕。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the court returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the court returned from the tour.

sentences.zh: 丁未，加錢陳群刑部尚書銜。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Qian Chenqun was given the titular rank of Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Qian Chenqun received the Minister of Punishments titular rank.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上奉皇太后渡江。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor, conducting the Empress Dowager, crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager across the river.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命濬築直隸各河堤，以工代賑。

translations.literal: On day yimao, dredging and construction of Zhili river dikes were ordered, using labor for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Zhili river dikes were to be dredged and built with work-for-relief labor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，移山西歸綏道駐綏遠城。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Shanxi Guiyuan circuit intendant was moved to be stationed at Suiyuan city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Shanxi's Guiyuan intendant was posted at Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 己未，上祭明太祖陵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor sacrificed at the tomb of Ming Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor sacrificed at Ming Taizu's tomb.

sentences.zh: 閱兵。

translations.literal: Troops were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor reviewed troops.

sentences.zh: 幸兩江總督尹繼善署。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the residence of Liangjiang governor-general Yin Jishan.
translations.idiomatic: The court visited Yin Jishan's Liangjiang governor-general residence.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免江蘇江甯、蘇州，杭州附郭諸縣本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, this year's quota land tax was remitted for suburban districts of Jiangsu Jiangning and Suzhou and Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, suburban taxes were waived for Jiangning, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜江南召試諸生程晉芳等五人舉人，與進士吳泰來等三人並授內閣中書。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, five Jiangnan examination candidates including Cheng Jinfang were granted licentiate rank, and three jinshi including Wu Tailai were together appointed Secretariat drafters.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Cheng Jinfang and four others became licentiates; Wu Tailai and two other jinshi received Secretariat posts.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上奉皇太后渡江。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor conducted the Empress Dowager across the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager across the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，上閱高家堰，諭濟運壩至運口接建磚工。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengwu: the Emperor inspected Gaojia Embankment and ordered brick works built continuously from the transport dam to the canal mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Emperor inspected Gaojia Embankment and ordered brick dikes from the transport dam to the canal mouth.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后渡河。

translations.literal: The Emperor conducted the Empress Dowager across the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The court escorted the Empress Dowager across the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 以大理寺少卿顧汝修奉使安南，擅移書詰責國王，褫職。

translations.literal: Because Grand Court of Revision vice minister Gu Ruxiu, on mission to Annam, had on his own authority sent a letter rebuking the king, he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Ruxiu was dismissed for rebuking the Annamese king without authority on his mission.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命莊親王允祿等由水程奉皇太后回蹕。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Prince Zhuang Yunlu and others were ordered to escort the Empress Dowager back by water.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Yunlu and others were to return the Empress Dowager by water route.

sentences.zh: 上登陸由徐州閱河。

translations.literal: The Emperor went ashore and inspected the river from Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor landed and inspected the canal from Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，免浙江仁和等十縣、湖州一所、仁和等五場上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, quota land tax for last year's flood was remitted for ten Zhejiang counties including Renhe, one office in Huzhou, and five salterns including Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, last year's flood taxes were waived in Zhejiang districts including Renhe.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上祭孟子廟，謁先師廟。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor sacrificed at the temple of Mencius and visited the temple of the Sage.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor worshipped at Mencius's temple and the Sage's temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上謁孔林。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor visited the Kong Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor visited Confucius's grove.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅安定等十州縣上年雹災。

translations.literal: Hail-disaster relief was distributed for ten Gansu prefectures and counties including Anding for last year.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's hail relief reached ten Gansu districts including Anding.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免山東齊河等四十四州縣衛所上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renwu, quota land tax for last year's flood was remitted for forty-four Shandong prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Qihe.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Shandong flood taxes were remitted in forty-four districts including Qihe.

sentences.zh: 戊子，皇太后登陸，駐蹕德州行宮。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Empress Dowager went ashore and halted at the Dezhou traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Empress Dowager landed and stayed at the Dezhou traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 己丑，上送皇太后登舟。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Emperor saw the Empress Dowager aboard her boat.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager onto her boat.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命劉統勳會勘景州疏築事宜。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Liu Tongxun was ordered jointly to survey dredging and construction at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Liu Tongxun was assigned to survey Jingzhou dredging works.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，免順直大興等十州縣廳逋賦。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, arrears in quota land tax were remitted for ten Zhili prefectures, counties, and departments including Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, tax arrears were forgiven in ten Zhili districts including Daxing.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，以乾清門行走額魯特鄂爾奇達遜奮勉勇往，賞三等伯爵。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: because the Qianqing Gate attendant Erchidason of the Elute had exerted himself bravely, he was rewarded with a third-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Elute attendant Erchidason received a third-rank baronage for brave service.

sentences.zh: 賑安徽壽州等十州縣衛上年水災。

translations.literal: Flood relief was distributed for ten Anhui prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Shouzhou for last year.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's flood relief reached ten Anhui districts including Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上至涿州。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor reached Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the court arrived at Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 哈薩克陪臣阿塔海等入覲，賜冠服有差。

translations.literal: Kazakh attendant ministers including Atahai were received in audience and granted graded caps and robes.
translations.idiomatic: Kazakh envoys including Atahai were received and given graded dress.

sentences.zh: 賑長蘆屬滄州等七州縣及嚴鎮等七場上年水災灶戶，並免賦有差。

translations.literal: Flood relief was distributed for saltern households in seven Changlu prefectures and counties including Cangzhou and seven salterns including Yanzhen for last year, and taxes were remitted with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Changlu saltern households in Cangzhou and other districts received graded flood relief and tax remissions.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上詣黃新莊迎皇太后居申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor went to Huangxinzhuang to welcome the Empress Dowager to reside at Shenchang Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor welcomed the Empress Dowager to Shenchang Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南武陵等四州縣上年水災，並免額賦有差。

translations.literal: Flood relief was distributed for four Hunan prefectures and counties including Wuling for last year, and quota land tax was remitted with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan flood relief and graded tax remissions reached four districts including Wuling.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，除安徽虹縣等四州縣衛水占窪地額賦。

translations.literal: On day guimao, quota land tax on flooded lowlands was abolished for four Anhui prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Hong county.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, taxes on flooded lowlands were lifted in four Anhui districts including Hong.

sentences.zh: 戊申，調鄂弼為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Ebi was transferred to be Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Ebi became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以紮拉豐阿為正白旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Zhalafeng'a was made chief commandant-attendant of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalafeng'a became Plain White Banner chief commandant-attendant.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以倭和為總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Wohe was made superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Wohe became Imperial Household superintendent.

sentences.zh: 閏五月癸亥朔，以清保年老，召來京。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, new moon on day guihai: because Qingbao was aged, he was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary fifth-month new moon, the aged Qingbao was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 調格舍圖為盛京將軍，朝銓署之。

translations.literal: Geshetu was transferred to be Mukden general, with Chaoyin acting.
translations.idiomatic: Geshetu became Mukden general and Chaoyin served in his stead.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，免湖北潛江等九州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, quota land tax for last year's flood was remitted for nine Hubei prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Qianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Hubei flood taxes were waived in nine districts including Qianjiang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，籍沒納延泰財產。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Nayantai's property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Nayantai's estate was seized.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命西安將軍如松襲封信郡王，以德昭之子修齡襲如松公爵。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Xi'an general Rusong was ordered to inherit as Prince of Feng; De Zhao's son Xiuling was to inherit Rusong's dukedom.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Rusong inherited as Prince of Feng and Xiuling succeeded his dukedom.

sentences.zh: 改察哈爾都統嵩椿為西安將軍，以巴爾品代之。

translations.literal: Chahar commander Songchun was changed to Xi'an general, with Ba'erpin replacing him.
translations.idiomatic: Songchun became Xi'an general and Ba'erpin took his Chahar command.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，免直隸固安七十四州縣廳上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingyou: quota land tax for last year's flood was remitted for seventy-four Zhili prefectures, counties, and departments including Gu'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, last year's flood taxes were remitted in seventy-four Zhili districts including Gu'an.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，召此次南巡接駕休致之編修沈齊禮來京，及因事降革之馮鎬等十三員引見。

translations.literal: On day renyin, compiler Shen Qili, retired after receiving the southern tour, was summoned to the capital, and thirteen officials demoted for offenses including Feng Hao were granted audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Shen Qili was recalled and Feng Hao and twelve others were presented after demotion.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以庫爾勒伯克等進貢，諭計直頒賞，仍通諭各城，非盛典進方物者皆止之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, because Korla begs and others presented tribute, an edict ordered rewards at assessed value and a general notice to all cities that non-ceremonial local products should cease.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Korla tribute was rewarded at value and other cities were told to stop non-ceremonial gifts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以原任將軍班第、參贊大臣鄂容安在伊犁竭忠全節，命于伊犁關帝廟後設位致祭。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, because former general Bandi and Grand Minister Resident Erong'an had died loyally at their posts in Yili, seats of sacrifice were ordered set up behind the Yili Guandi Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, memorial seats were established at Yili for Bandi and Erong'an.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，以朝鮮三水府滋事逃人越境，命恆祿等赴邊境查勘。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renxu: because troublemakers from Korea's Sanshui prefecture had fled across the border, Henglu and others were ordered to the frontier to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Henglu was sent to the border after Korean fugitives crossed over.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免安徽壽州等十六州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day guihai, quota land tax for last year's flood was remitted for sixteen Anhui prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Anhui flood taxes were waived in sixteen districts including Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上奉皇太后巡幸木蘭，免經過地方本年錢糧十分之五。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor conducted the Empress Dowager on a tour to Mulan and remitted five-tenths of this year's grain taxes for places through which the court passed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the court toured Mulan and transit districts received a fifty-percent tax cut.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，霍罕侵據額德格訥阿濟畢布魯特之鄂斯等處，諭永貴檄霍罕還之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Kokand had seized Ous and other places of the Edegena Ajibi Kirghiz; Yonggui was ordered to memorialize Kokand to return them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yonggui was told to demand Kokand restore Kirghiz lands at Ous.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，建伊犁之固勒劄、烏哈爾裏克兩城，賜名綏定、安遠。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengzi: two cities in Yili, Gulezha and Uhalirik, were built and named Suide and Anyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Yili cities Gulezha and Uhalirik were founded as Suide and Anyuan.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: The Emperor conducted the Empress Dowager back to lodge at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding Summer Heat.
translations.idiomatic: The court returned the Empress Dowager to the summer resort.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，讬恩多丁憂，調明山署廣東巡撫，蘇昌兼署，湯聘為江西巡撫，以宋邦綏為湖北巡撫，愛必達兼署。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, because Tuo'enduo was in mourning, Mingshan was transferred to act as Guangdong governor, Suchang additionally acting; Tang Pin was made Jiangxi governor; Song Bangsui was made Hubei governor, with Aibida additionally acting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, mourning for Tuo'enduo brought a round of acting and new governors in the south.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免順直文安等十七州縣廳逋賦及寧河等五縣本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renzi, arrears in quota land tax were remitted for seventeen Zhili prefectures, counties, and departments including Wen'an, and this year's flood taxes for five counties including Ninghe.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Zhili arrears and Ninghe flood taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賜察哈爾都統敕書。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Chahar commander was granted an imperial patent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Chahar commander received an imperial commission.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江將軍綽勒多卒，調國多歡代之。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang general Chuoleduo died; Guoduohuan was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Chuoleduo died and Guoduohuan became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，賞自哈薩克來投之塔爾巴哈沁額魯特巴桑銀綺。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guihai: Basang, an Elute of Tacheng who had come over from the Kazakhs, was rewarded with silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Kazakh defector Basang of Tacheng received silks.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上奉皇太后回蹕。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor conducted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the court returned the Empress Dowager to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，巴達克山素勒坦沙遣使入覲。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Badakhshan's sultan sent envoys to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Badakhshan's sultan presented envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命乾清門侍衛明仁帶御醫馳視胡寶瑔疾。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Qianqing Gate guard Mingren was ordered to take an imperial physician posthaste to treat Hu Baohan's illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Mingren was sent with a court physician to Hu Baohan.

sentences.zh: 賑山東齊河等三十五州縣衛水災，並免額賦。

translations.literal: Flood relief was distributed for thirty-five Shandong prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Qihe, and quota land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong flood relief and tax remissions reached thirty-five districts including Qihe.

sentences.zh: 甲申，建烏魯木齊城堡，賜城名曰甯邊、輯懷，堡名曰宣仁、懷義、樂全、寶昌、惠徠、屢豐。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Urumqi fortresses were built; the cities were named Ningbian and Jihuai, and the forts Xuanren, Huaiyi, Lequan, Baochang, Huilai, and Lüfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Urumqi gained cities Ningbian and Jihuai and six named forts.

sentences.zh: 戊子，理籓院尚書、領侍衛內大臣富德以索取蒙古王公馬畜，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Board of Colonial Affairs minister and chief commandant-attendant Fude was stripped of office and arrested for questioning for demanding horses and livestock from Mongol princes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Fude was dismissed and arrested for extorting Mongol princes.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以新柱為理籓院尚書，明瑞為正白旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Xinzhu was made Board of Colonial Affairs minister and Mingrui chief commandant-attendant of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Xinzhu headed the Board of Colonial Affairs and Mingrui the Plain White Banner guard.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，調陳宏謀為湖南巡撫，宋邦綏署之，莊有恭為江蘇巡撫，熊學鵬為浙江巡撫，馮鈐為廣西巡撫，顧濟美護之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinmao: Chen Hongmou was transferred to Hunan governor, with Song Bangsui acting; Zhuang Yougong was made Jiangsu governor; Xiong Xuepeng Zhejiang governor; Feng Qian Guangxi governor, with Gu Jimei protecting.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, several southern governorships were reassigned and filled with acting officers.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，緬目宮裏雁以焚殺孟連土司刀派春全家，命處斬，傳首示眾。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Burmese chief Gongliyan, for burning and killing the entire family of Menglian native official Dao Paichun, was ordered executed and his head displayed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Gongliyan was executed and his head shown for murdering Dao Paichun's household.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以愛烏罕汗愛哈默特沙遣使入貢，諭沿途督撫預備筵宴，並命額勒登額護送。

translations.literal: On day guimao, because the Afghan ruler Ahmad Shah had sent envoys with tribute, governors along the route were ordered to prepare banquets, and Eledeng'e was ordered to escort them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Afghan tribute envoys were to be feasted en route under Eledeng'e's escort.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，設總管伊犁等處將軍，以明瑞為之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, a general-in-chief post was established for Yili and dependencies, with Mingrui appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Mingrui became general-in-chief of Yili.

sentences.zh: 命築科布多城。

translations.literal: Construction of Kobdo city was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo city was ordered built.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賑順直霸州等六十三州縣廳水雹霜災，免江蘇清河等十七州縣衛本年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, flood, hail, and frost relief was distributed for sixty-three Zhili prefectures, counties, and departments including Bazhou, and this year's flood taxes were remitted for seventeen Jiangsu prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Zhili disaster relief and Jiangsu flood tax remissions were granted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賑浙江仁和等二十八州縣衛場水災。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, flood relief was distributed for twenty-eight Zhejiang prefectures, counties, guards, salterns, and fields including Renhe.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Zhejiang flood relief reached twenty-eight districts including Renhe.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，奉天府府尹通福壽以徇縱治中高錦勒索商人，解任鞫治。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Fengtian prefect Tong Fushou was removed and tried for indulging magistrate Gao Jin in extorting merchants.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Tong Fushou was dismissed for shielding Gao Jin's merchant extortion.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未朔，濬山東德州運河。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day jiwei: the Dezhou section of the Shandong Grand Canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh-month new moon, Shandong's Dezhou canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 庚申，設伊犁參贊大臣，以愛隆阿、伊勒圖為之。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Yili Grand Minister Residents were established, with Ailong'a and Yiletu appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Ailong'a and Yiletu became Yili Grand Minister Residents.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，設伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yili brigade commanders were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yili brigade commanders were created.

sentences.zh: 命明瑞等率兵驅逐塔爾巴哈臺山陰之哈喇巴哈等處越牧哈薩克。

translations.literal: Mingrui and others were ordered to lead troops to drive off Kazakhs pasturing beyond bounds at Halabaha and other places north of the Tacheng mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Mingrui was to expel trespassing Kazakhs north of Tacheng.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以薩魯布魯特頭目沙巴圖交還所掠霍罕貿易人等馬匹，諭永貴等酌賞之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, because Saru Kirghiz chief Shabatu had returned horses seized from Kokand traders, Yonggui and others were ordered to reward him as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Shabatu was to be rewarded for returning Kokand traders' horses.

sentences.zh: 呼什齊布魯特為霍罕所侵來投，命移于阿拉克圖呼勒等處遊牧。

translations.literal: Kirghiz of Khoshchi, invaded by Kokand, came over; they were ordered moved to pasture at Alaketughule and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Khoshchi Kirghiz refugees were resettled at Alaketughule after Kokand's attack.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命博斯和勒為杜爾伯特盟長，設副將軍二員，以車淩烏巴什為右翼副將軍，巴桑為左翼副將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Boshosle was made league chief of the Dorbet; two deputy generals were established, with Cheleng Ubashi right deputy and Basang left deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Boshosle headed the Dorbet league and Cheleng Ubashi and Basang became deputies.

sentences.zh: 辛未，建喀什噶爾新城。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, a new city was built at Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Kashgar's new city was founded.

sentences.zh: 壬申，改山西平魯營參將為都司，裁原設中軍守備及井坪營都司。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Shanxi Pinglu garrison vice commander was changed to commandant; the former middle garrison commandant and Jingping garrison commandant were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Pinglu's vice commander became commandant and two Shanxi posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 丙子，哈薩克努爾賚、烏爾根齊城哈雅克等遣使入覲。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Kazakh Nurbai and Khayaq of Urgenchi city and others sent envoys to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Kazakh envoys including Nurbai were received.

sentences.zh: 甲申，諭方觀承仿河南濬道路溝洫。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Fang Guancheng was instructed to follow Henan in dredging roads, ditches, and canals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Fang Guancheng was told to dredge roads and drains like Henan.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅皋蘭等二十廳州縣本年冰雹霜雪災。

translations.literal: Hail, frost, and snow relief was distributed for twenty Gansu departments, prefectures, and counties including Gaolan for this year.
translations.idiomatic: This year's hail and snow relief reached twenty Gansu districts including Gaolan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，濬山東壽張等州縣河道溝渠。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, rivers, canals, and ditches in Shandong prefectures and counties including Shouzhang were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, waterways were dredged in Shandong districts including Shouzhang.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，大學士史貽直以老病乞休，優詔慰留，命不必兼攝工部，以示體恤。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengyin: Grand Secretary Shi Yizhi, citing age and illness, begged retirement; a gracious edict comforted and retained him and ordered that he need not additionally hold the Works Ministry, as a mark of consideration.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Shi Yizhi's retirement plea was gently refused and his Works portfolio waived.

sentences.zh: 丙申，克什密爾呢雅斯伯克請入覲，允之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Kashmir beg Niyas asked to come to audience; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Kashmir beg Niyas was permitted an audience.

sentences.zh: 霍罕呈書，以布魯特鄂斯故地為己有，諭永貴等嚴檄令給還。

translations.literal: Kokand presented a letter claiming Kirghiz land at Ous as its own; Yonggui and others were ordered to send a stern memorial demanding its return.
translations.idiomatic: Kokand was sternly told to return Kirghiz lands at Ous.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以霍罕伯克復永貴等書謂前遣使人奉旨稱為汗，欲以喀什噶爾為界，諭嚴檄斥駁之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, because the Kokand beg had replied to Yonggui that earlier envoys had been titled khan by imperial order and he wished to take Kashgar as his border, an edict ordered a stern memorial of rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Kokand's claim to khan status and Kashgar was sharply rebuked.

sentences.zh: 丁未，工部尚書歸宣光卒，以董邦達代之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Works Minister Gui Xuangguang died; Dong Bangda replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Gui Xuangguang died and Dong Bangda became Works minister.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命納世通赴喀什噶爾辦事，代永貴回京。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Nashitong was ordered to affairs at Kashgar, replacing Yonggui's return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Nashitong went to Kashgar and Yonggui returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，巴達克山侵圍博羅爾，諭新柱等嚴檄責令息兵，並索獻布拉尼敦妻孥。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Badakhshan besieged Boluor; Xinzhu and others were ordered to send stern memorials demanding a ceasefire and the surrender of Burhan al-Din's wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Badakhshan was ordered to lift the siege of Boluor and hand over Burhan al-Din's family.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月庚申，賑順直屬之霸州等三十五州縣、山東齊河等三十州縣衛水災有差。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, spring, first month, day gengshen: flood relief was distributed with distinctions for thirty-five Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou and thirty Shandong prefectures, counties, guards, and posts including Qihe.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the twenty-eighth year, graded flood relief reached Zhili and Shandong districts including Bazhou and Qihe.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上御紫光閣，賜愛烏罕、巴達克山、霍罕、哈薩克各部使人宴。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor held court at the Hall of Purple Glazed Light and granted a banquet to envoys from Afghanistan, Badakhshan, Kokand, and the Kazakh tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Emperor feasted Afghan, Badakhshan, Kokand, and Kazakh envoys at Ziguang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上大閱申昜春園之西廠，命各部使人從觀。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor held a great review at the western parade ground of Shenchang Spring Garden and ordered envoys of all tribes to observe.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor reviewed troops at Shenchang Spring Garden before foreign envoys.

sentences.zh: 以法起為歸化城都統。

translations.literal: Faqi was made commander at Guihuacheng.
translations.idiomatic: Faqi became Guihuacheng commander.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命阿桂在軍機處行走。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Agui was ordered to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Agui joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 壬午，河南巡撫胡寶瑔卒，以葉存仁為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Henan governor Hu Baohan died; Ye Cunren was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Hu Baohan died and Ye Cunren became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以納世通為參贊大臣，駐喀什噶爾，總理回疆事務。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Nashitong was made Grand Minister Resident, stationed at Kashgar to oversee Muslim frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Nashitong became resident minister at Kashgar over the Muslim frontier.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命方觀承赴河南會勘漳河工程。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Fang Guancheng was ordered to Henan jointly to survey Zhang River works.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Fang Guancheng was sent to survey the Zhang River in Henan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，改西安滿洲、漢軍副都統為左右翼副都統。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Xi'an Manchu and Chinese Banner lieutenant-generals were changed to left and right wing lieutenant-generals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Xi'an Banner lieutenant-generals were reorganized into left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，裁西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Xining resident minister post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Xining resident minister was cut.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor visited Zhaoxi Mausoleum, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor worshipped at Zhaoxi, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, and Jingling.

sentences.zh: 是日，回蹕。

translations.literal: That day, the court returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: That day, the court returned from the journey.

sentences.zh: 改烏魯木齊副將為總兵。

translations.literal: The deputy commander at Urumqi was changed to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Urumqi's deputy commander was made a regional commander.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命侍郎裘曰修督辦直隸水利。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu was ordered to supervise Zhili waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Qiu Yuexiu was put in charge of Zhili water conservancy.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，上還京師。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiwei day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，免山東齊河等三十一州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day renshen, quota land tax was remitted for thirty-one Shandong prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Qihe on account of flood.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, thirty-one Shandong units including Qihe were excused flood quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor visited Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor visited Tailing.

sentences.zh: 是日，回蹕。

translations.literal: That day, the court returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: That day, the court returned from the journey.

sentences.zh: 賞寧津縣百有三歲壽民李友益及其子侄孫銀牌緞疋有差。

translations.literal: Li Youyi of Ningjin County, a centenarian of one hundred three years, and his sons, nephews, and grandsons were rewarded with silver plates and lengths of satin with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Ningjin centenarian Li Youyi and his kin were given silver plates and satin by rank.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，設伊犁額魯特總管三員，副總管以下員額有差。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, three Ili Oirat superintendents were established, with varying numbers of deputy superintendents and subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, three Ili Oirat superintendents were set up with graded subordinates.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命福德赴庫倫，同桑齋多爾濟辦事。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Fude was ordered to proceed to Kulun to handle affairs with Sangzhai Duorji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Fude was sent to Kulun with Sangzhai Duorji.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，免江蘇清河等十四州縣衛水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, quota land tax was remitted for fourteen Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Qinghe on account of flood.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, fourteen Jiangsu units including Qinghe were excused flood quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬辰，賑浙江錢塘等十七州縣場上年水災。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renchen: relief was given for last year's flood in seventeen Zhejiang prefectures, counties, and salt-fields including Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, seventeen Zhejiang units including Qiantang were relieved for last year's flood.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，雨。

translations.literal: On day yisi, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 戊申，法起以贓免。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Fa Qi was dismissed for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Fa Qi was removed for graft.

sentences.zh: 以傅良為歸化城都統。

translations.literal: Fu Liang was made commander at Guihua City.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Liang became Guihua City commander.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜秦大成等一百八十八人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Qin Dacheng and one hundred eighty-eight others were granted jinshi and other degrees with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Qin Dacheng and 188 others received jinshi degrees with graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，裁歸化城都統。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the post of commander at Guihua City was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Guihua City commander post was cut.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，圓明園火。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: Yuanmingyuan caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Yuanmingyuan burned.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命尚書阿桂往直隸霸州等處，會同侍郎裘曰修、總督方觀承督辦疏濬事。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Minister Agui was ordered to Bazhou and other places in Zhili to join Vice Minister Qiu Yuexiu and Governor-General Fang Guancheng in supervising dredging.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Agui joined Qiu Yuexiu and Fang Guancheng to dredge Zhili waterways.

sentences.zh: 以舒赫德署工部尚書。

translations.literal: Shuhede was made acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Shuhede acted as Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲子，封朝鮮國王孫李算為世孫。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Li Suan, grandson of the King of Korea, was enfeoffed as heir grandson.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Korean heir grandson Li Suan was enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，果親王弘適以幹與朝政削王爵，仍賞給貝勒。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Prince Guo Hongshi was stripped of princely rank for meddling in court affairs but was still granted beile.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Prince Guo Hongshi lost his princedom for interfering in government but kept beile rank.

sentences.zh: 和親王弘晝以儀節僭妄，罰俸三年。

translations.literal: Prince He Hongzhou was fined three years' salary for ceremonial impropriety.
translations.idiomatic: Prince He Hongzhou lost three years' pay for ritual excess.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大學士史貽直卒。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Grand Secretary Shi Yizhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Grand Secretary Shi Yizhi died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上試翰林、詹事等官，擢王文治等三員為一等，餘各升黜有差。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor examined Hanlin and related officials; Wang Wenzhi and three others were ranked first class, the rest promoted or demoted by grade.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Hanlin officials were examined; Wang Wenzhi and three others took first rank.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on the autumn mulan hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on the autumn mulan hunt.

sentences.zh: 以李侍堯為湖廣總督，輔德為湖北巡撫，陳宏謀兼署之。

translations.literal: Li Shiyao was made Huguang governor-general; Fude was made Hubei governor, with Chen Hongmou acting.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiyao became Huguang governor-general; Fude took Hubei and Chen Hongmou acted.

sentences.zh: 調劉綸為戶部尚書，仍兼署兵部。

translations.literal: Liu Lun was transferred to Minister of Revenue while still acting as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lun became Minister of Revenue and still acted at War.

sentences.zh: 以陳宏謀為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Chen Hongmou was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hongmou became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 調喬光烈為湖南巡撫，來朝署之。

translations.literal: Qiao Guanglie was transferred to Hunan governor; Laichao acted in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Guanglie went to Hunan and Laichao acted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以崔應階為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Cui Yingjie was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Cui Yingjie became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，調明德為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Mingde was transferred to Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Mingde became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以和其衷為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: He Qizhong was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: He Qizhong became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命福德往庫倫辦事，仍帶署理籓院侍郎銜。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Fude was ordered to proceed to Kulun on affairs, still bearing the acting title of Lifan Yuan vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Fude went to Kulun with an acting Lifan Yuan vice minister title.

sentences.zh: 以額爾景額為參贊大臣，往葉爾羌辦事。

translations.literal: Erjingge was made consultant minister and sent to Yarkand on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Erjingge was sent to Yarkand as consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，山東曆城等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengyin: locusts in Shandong prefectures and counties including Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, locusts struck Shandong units including Licheng.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賑甘肅狄道等三十廳州縣水旱霜雹災。

translations.literal: On day renchen, relief was given for flood, drought, and hail in thirty Gansu garrisons, prefectures, and counties including Didao.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, thirty Gansu units including Didao were relieved for flood, drought, and hail.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，開泰以恇怯規避免。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Kai Tai was dismissed for cowardice and evading duty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Kai Tai was removed for timidity and shirking.

sentences.zh: 以鄂弼為四川總督，明山為陝西巡撫，阿裏袞署之，阿思哈為廣東巡撫，蘇昌兼署，命阿思哈先署廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: E Bi was made Sichuan governor-general; Ming Shan was made Shaanxi governor with Aligun acting; Asiha was made Guangdong governor with Suchang acting, and Asiha was first ordered to act as Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: E Bi took Sichuan; Ming Shan went to Shaanxi with Aligun acting; Asiha took Guangdong with Suchang acting and first held Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，四川總督鄂弼卒。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Sichuan Governor-General E Bi died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Sichuan Governor-General E Bi died.

sentences.zh: 以阿勒泰為四川總督，崔應階為山東巡撫，圖勒炳阿為貴州巡撫，吳達善兼署雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Aletai was made Sichuan governor-general; Cui Yingjie was made Shandong governor; Tulebing'a was made Guizhou governor; Wu Dashan acted as Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Aletai took Sichuan, Cui Yingjie Shandong, Tulebing'a Guizhou, and Wu Dashan acted in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 以梁詩正為東閣大學士，劉綸協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Liang Shizheng was made Eastern Pavilion Grand Secretary; Liu Lun was made assisting Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Shizheng became Eastern Pavilion Grand Secretary and Liu Lun assisting Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 調陳宏謀為吏部尚書，彭啟豐為兵部尚書，張泰開為左都御史。

translations.literal: Chen Hongmou was transferred to Minister of Personnel; Peng Qifeng to Minister of War; Zhang Taikai to Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hongmou took Personnel, Peng Qifeng War, and Zhang Taikai the censorate.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上幸簡親王第視疾。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor visited Prince Jian's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the Emperor called on the ailing Prince Jian.

sentences.zh: 壬子，簡親王奇通阿卒。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Prince Jian Qitong'a died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Prince Jian Qitong'a died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，英廉丁憂，命舒赫德兼署戶部尚書，劉綸留部治事。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengshen: Yinglian entered mourning; Shuhede was ordered to act as Minister of Revenue while Liu Lun remained at the ministry to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Yinglian mourned; Shuhede acted at Revenue and Liu Lun stayed on duty.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，仍設西寧辦事大臣，以七十五為之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Xining commissioner post was re-established, with Qishiwu appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, the Xining commissioner was restored under Qishiwu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，順直大城、滄州等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: On day jisi, locusts in Zhili prefectures and counties including Dacheng and Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, locusts struck Zhili units including Dacheng and Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，履親王允祹卒。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Prince Lu Yuntang died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Prince Lu Yuntang died.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，賜烏魯木齊城名曰迪化，特訥格爾城名曰阜康。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guisi: Urumqi city was given the name Dihua and Teneggel city the name Fukang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Urumqi was named Dihua and Teneggel Fukang.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上奉皇太后幸木蘭，行圍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, went to Mulan for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the court with the Empress Dowager hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯朔，日食。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day yimao: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth-month new moon of yimao, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上奉皇太后回駐避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to lodge at the Mountain Resort to Escape the Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the court with the Empress Dowager returned to the summer resort.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上奉皇太后回蹕。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned from the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the court with the Empress Dowager returned from tour.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，改甘肅臨洮道為驛傳道，兼巡蘭州府，洮岷道為分巡鞏秦階道。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Lintao circuit in Gansu was changed to the courier circuit with concurrent inspection of Lanzhou prefecture, and the Taomin circuit to the circuit touring Gong, Qin, and Jie.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Gansu circuit posts were reorganized at Lintao and Taomin.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the court with the Empress Dowager returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，加梁詩正、高晉太子太傅，兆惠、劉綸、阿裏袞、舒赫德、秦蕙田、阿桂、陳宏謀、楊錫紱、楊廷璋、李侍堯、蘇昌、阿勒泰太子太保，莊有恭、劉藻太子少保。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiashen: Liang Shizheng and Gao Jin were made Grand Tutors of the Heir Apparent; Zhao Hui, Liu Lun, Aligun, Shuhede, Qin Huixuan, Agui, Chen Hongmou, Yang Xizhuo, Yang Tingzhang, Li Shiyao, Suchang, and Aletai Senior Guardians; Zhuang Yougong and Liu Zao Junior Guardians.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Liang Shizheng and Gao Jin became Grand Tutors; Zhao Hui and twelve others Senior Guardians; Zhuang Yougong and Liu Zao Junior Guardians.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上臨奠履親王允祹。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor personally mourned Prince Lu Yuntang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor mourned Prince Lu Yuntang in person.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免江蘇銅山等九州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, quota land tax was remitted for nine Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Tongshan on account of flood.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, nine Jiangsu units including Tongshan were excused flood quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅朔，召成袞紮布來京，以紮拉豐阿署烏裏雅蘇台將軍，雅郎阿留科布多。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day jiayin: Chenggunjab was summoned to the capital; Zhalafeng'a acted as Uriankhai general and Yalang'a remained at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh-month new moon, Chenggunjab was called to Beijing; Zhalafeng'a acted at Uriankhai and Yalang'a stayed at Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，河東河道總督張師載卒，以葉存仁代之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Hedong River-course Governor-General Zhang Shizai died; Ye Cunren replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Zhang Shizai died; Ye Cunren became Hedong river-course governor-general.

sentences.zh: 調阿思哈為河南巡撫，明山為廣東巡撫，明德為陝西巡撫，輔德為江西巡撫，常鈞為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Asiha was transferred to Henan governor; Ming Shan to Guangdong governor; Mingde to Shaanxi governor; Fude to Jiangxi governor; and Chang Jun to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Asiha went to Henan, Ming Shan to Guangdong, Mingde to Shaanxi, Fude to Jiangxi, and Chang Jun to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 以楊應琚兼署甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: Yang Yingju was made acting Gansu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingju acted as Gansu governor.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大學士梁詩正卒。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Grand Secretary Liang Shizheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Grand Secretary Liang Shizheng died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以楊廷璋為體仁閣大學士，仍留閩浙總督任。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yang Tingzhang was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Extending Benevolence while retaining his post as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yang Tingzhang became a grand secretary but kept Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，免直隸延慶等十州縣雹旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: quota land tax was remitted for ten Zhili prefectures and counties including Yanqing on account of hail and drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, ten Zhili units including Yanqing were excused hail and drought quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賑甘肅皋蘭等十二廳縣旱災饑民。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, drought relief was given for famine victims in twelve Gansu garrisons and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, twelve Gansu units including Gaolan received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑山東濟寧等八州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, relief was given for flood in eight Shandong prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, eight Shandong units including Jining were relieved for flood.

sentences.zh: 乙未，召國多歡來京，調富僧阿為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Guoduohuan was summoned to the capital; Fuseng'a was transferred to Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Guoduohuan was called to Beijing and Fuseng'a became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 庚子，休致左都御史梅成卒。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, retired Censor-in-chief Mei Cheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, retired Censor-in-chief Mei Cheng died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命綽克托赴烏魯木齊辦事，代旌額裏回京。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Zhuoketu was ordered to proceed to Urumqi on affairs, replacing Jing'e'li returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Zhuoketu went to Urumqi in place of Jing'e'li.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月癸丑朔，賑山東濟寧等七州縣衛、甘肅永昌等二十四廳州縣災民。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, new moon on day guichou: relief was given for disaster victims in seven Shandong prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Jining and twenty-four Gansu garrisons, prefectures, and counties including Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 29, seven Shandong and twenty-four Gansu units including Jining and Yongchang received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，加賑雲南江川等五州縣地震災民，並免額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, added relief was given for earthquake victims in five Yunnan prefectures and counties including Jiangchuan, and quota land tax was also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, five Yunnan units including Jiangchuan received added earthquake relief and tax remission.

sentences.zh: 己卯，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，命阿敏爾圖駐藏辦事，代福鼐回京。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: Amin'ertu was ordered to remain in Tibet on affairs, replacing Funai returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Amin'ertu stayed in Tibet in place of Funai.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上謁泰陵。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor visited Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor visited Tailing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命觀音保赴伊犁，代愛隆阿回京。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Guanyinbao was ordered to proceed to Ili, replacing Ailong'a returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Guanyinbao went to Ili in place of Ailong'a.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免上年直隸蔚州雹災、萬全縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, quota land tax was remitted for last year's hail disaster in Zhili's Yuzhou and drought disaster in Wanquan County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Yuzhou hail and Wanquan drought taxes were excused.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免湖北沔陽等三州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, quota land tax was remitted for three Hubei prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Mianyang on account of last year's flood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, three Hubei units including Mianyang were excused last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，太子太傅、大學士來保卒。

translations.literal: Third month, day guichou: Laibao, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Grand Secretary, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Grand Secretary Laibao died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，移陝甘總督駐蘭州，兼管甘肅巡撫事，裁甘肅巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general was moved to Lanzhou and given concurrent charge of Gansu governor affairs; the Gansu governor post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general moved to Lanzhou and absorbed Gansu governorship.

sentences.zh: 移固原提督回駐西安。

translations.literal: The Guyuan regional commander was moved back to be stationed at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: The Guyuan commander returned to Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 改河州鎮總兵為固原鎮總兵。

translations.literal: The Hezhou regional commander was changed to Guyuan regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhou commander became Guyuan regional commander.

sentences.zh: 免山東濟寧等七州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land tax was remitted for seven Shandong prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Jining on account of last year's flood.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Shandong units including Jining were excused last year's flood quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上臨故大學士來保第賜奠。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor went to the late Grand Secretary Laibao's residence to offer mourning gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor mourned Laibao at his home.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇銅山等二十八州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota land tax was remitted for twenty-eight Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Tongshan on account of last year's flood.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-eight Jiangsu units including Tongshan were excused last year's flood quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命兆惠署工部尚書，阿桂赴西寧會同七十五及章嘉呼圖克圖選派郭羅克頭目。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Zhao Hui was ordered to act as Minister of Works; Agui was sent to Xining to join Qishiwu and the Changkya Khutuktu in selecting Golok headmen.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Zhao Hui acted at Works and Agui went to Xining with Qishiwu and the Changkya Khutuktu for Golok headmen.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，賑甘肅金縣等縣旱災。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiawu: relief was given for drought in Gansu counties including Jin County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Gansu counties including Jin County received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子朔，諭粵海關官貢毋進珍珠等物。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day renzi: an edict instructed Guangdong customs officials not to present pearls and the like as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon, Guangdong customs was told not to send pearls as tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以讬恩多署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Tuo Enduo was made acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Tuo Enduo acted as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，賑湖南武岡等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: relief was given for flood in Hunan prefectures and counties including Wugang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Hunan units including Wugang were relieved for flood.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命玉桂赴北路，代紮拉豐阿回京。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Yugui was ordered to the northern route, replacing Zhalafeng'a returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Yugui went north in place of Zhalafeng'a.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，河東河道總督葉存仁卒，以李宏代之。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Hedong River-course Governor-General Ye Cunren died; Li Hong replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Ye Cunren died; Li Hong became Hedong river-course governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，奉天寧遠等州縣蝗。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, locusts in Fengtian prefectures and counties including Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, locusts struck Fengtian units including Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑廣東英德等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, relief was given for flood in Guangdong counties including Yingde.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Guangdong counties including Yingde were relieved for flood.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，調蘇昌為閩浙總督，李侍堯為兩廣總督，明山署之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Suchang was transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general; Li Shiyao to Liang-Guang governor-general, with Ming Shan acting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Suchang took Fujian-Zhejiang, Li Shiyao Liang-Guang with Ming Shan acting.

sentences.zh: 調吳達善為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Wu Dashan was transferred to Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dashan became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以劉藻為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Liu Zao was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zao became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，調常鈞為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Chang Jun was transferred to be Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Chang Jun became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 以王檢為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Wang Jian was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命阿勒泰回四川總督。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Aletai was ordered to return as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Aletai was sent back to Sichuan as governor-general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥朔，以楊應琚為大學士，留陝甘總督任，陳宏謀協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, first day xinhai: Yang Yingqiong was made Grand Secretary while retaining Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general; Chen Hongmou was made Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinhai new moon, Yang Yingqiong joined the Grand Secretariat but stayed at Shaanxi-Gansu; Chen Hongmou became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命常鈞暫兼署湖廣總督，劉藻兼署雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Chang Jun was ordered temporarily to act as Huguang governor-general; Liu Zao to act as Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Chang Jun doubled as Huguang governor-general and Liu Zao as Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，湖北黃梅等州縣江溢，命撫恤災民。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, rivers overflowed in Hubei prefectures and counties including Huangmei; disaster victims were ordered relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Huangmei and other Hubei counties flooded and victims were to be relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，湖南湘陰等州縣湖水溢，命賑恤災民。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, lake waters overflowed in Hunan prefectures and counties including Xiangyin; disaster victims were ordered relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Xiangyin and other Hunan counties flooded and victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on the autumn mulan hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on the autumn mulan hunt.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上奉皇太后駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to halt at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the court halted at the Summer Mountain Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賑安徽當塗等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, flood disaster in Anhui prefectures and counties including Dangtu was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Dangtu and other Anhui counties received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，免甘肅皋蘭等三十二州縣廳本年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinsi: this year's drought quota taxes were remitted for thirty-two Gansu prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinsi, thirty-two Gansu units including Gaolan were excused drought taxes.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，諭阿勒泰等曉諭綽斯甲布九土司會攻金川。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Aletai and others were instructed to explain to the nine chieftains of Zhuosijia that they should join in attacking Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Aletai was told to rally Zhuosijia's nine chiefs for a joint attack on Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上奉皇太后巡幸木蘭，行圍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on a tour to mulan for the enclosure hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Empress Dowager toured mulan for the enclosure hunt.

sentences.zh: 秦蕙田以病解任，以劉綸兼署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Qin Huitian resigned for illness; Liu Lun was ordered to act as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Huitian left office ill and Liu Lun acted as Rites minister.

sentences.zh: 庚子，增伊犁、雅爾等處領隊大臣各二員。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, two additional commandant posts were added each at Ili, Yar, and other stations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Ili, Yar, and other posts each gained two more commandants.

sentences.zh: 以綽克托為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Zhuoketuo was made councillor at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuoketuo became Tarbagatai councillor.

sentences.zh: 命伍彌泰等仍留烏魯木齊辦事。

translations.literal: Wu Mitai and others were ordered to remain at Urumqi on duty.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mitai and others stayed on at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，命刑部侍郎阿永阿會同吳達善讞湖南新寧縣民傳帖罷市獄。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiwei: Vice Minister of Punishments Ayong'a was ordered, together with Wu Dashan, to judge the case of people in Hunan's Xinning County who had circulated placards to stop the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiwei, Ayong'a and Wu Dashan were to try Xinning's placard boycott case.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賑江西南昌等八縣水災，並免額賦。

translations.literal: On day guihai, flood disaster in eight Jiangxi counties including Nanchang was relieved and quota taxes remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, eight Jiangxi counties including Nanchang were flood-relieved and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，刑部尚書秦蕙田卒，以莊有恭代之，暫留江蘇巡撫任。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Minister of Punishments Qin Huitian died; Zhuang Yougong replaced him while temporarily retaining Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Qin Huitian died; Zhuang Yougong took his ministry but kept Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上奉皇太后回駐避暑山莊。
