translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to halt at the Mountain Resort for Summer Retreat.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the court returned to the Summer Mountain Resort with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，喬光烈以新寧罷市獄褫職，調圖勒炳阿為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guisi: Qiao Guanglie was stripped of office for the Xinning market-stoppage case; Tulebing'a was transferred to be Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on guisi, Qiao Guanglie lost office over Xinning and Tulebing'a became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 以方世俊為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Fang Shijun was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Shijun became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以讬恩多為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Tuoenduo was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Tuoenduo became Colonial Affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，山東進牡丹。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Shandong presented peonies as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Shandong sent peonies.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賑江蘇上元等六州縣災民。

translations.literal: On day renyin, disaster victims in six Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Shangyuan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, six Jiangsu units including Shangyuan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，召鍾音回京。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Zhong Yin was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Zhong Yin was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 調富明安赴葉爾羌辦事。

translations.literal: Fuming'an was transferred to Yarkand for duty.
translations.idiomatic: Fuming'an was sent to Yarkand on duty.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賑安徽懷寧等十九州縣衛水災。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, flood disaster in nineteen Anhui prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Huaining was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, nineteen Anhui units including Huaining received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，賑甘肅皋蘭等二十廳州縣旱災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renzi: drought disaster in twenty Gansu subprefectures, prefectures, and counties including Gaolan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renzi, twenty Gansu units including Gaolan received drought relief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，築呼圖壁城成，賜名曰景化。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the walling of Hutubi city was completed and the name Jinghua was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Hutubi was finished and named Jinghua.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，免湖南武岡等二州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, flood quota taxes were remitted for two Hunan prefectures and counties including Wugang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Wugang and one other Hunan county were excused flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅皋蘭等十五廳州縣水雹災。

translations.literal: Rain-and-hail disaster in fifteen Gansu subprefectures, prefectures, and counties including Gaolan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen Gansu units including Gaolan received hailstorm relief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，協辦大學士、戶部尚書兆惠卒，上臨奠。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Revenue Zhaohui died; the Emperor attended in person to offer mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Zhaohui died and the Emperor mourned him in person.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以阿裏袞為戶部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Arigun was made Minister of Revenue and Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Arigun became Revenue minister and associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 調讬恩多為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Tuoenduo was transferred to be Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoenduo became War minister.

sentences.zh: 以五吉為理籓院尚書，兆德為正黃旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Wuji was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; Zhaode was made Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard for the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wuji took Colonial Affairs and Zhaode became Plain Yellow Banner bodyguard minister.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅朔，以常復為烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day wuyin: Chang Fu was made councillor at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month's wuyin new moon, Chang Fu became Uliastai councillor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賑湖北黃梅等州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, flood disaster in Hubei prefectures and counties including Huangmei was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Huangmei and other Hubei counties were flood-relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲午，禮部尚書陳德華病免，調董邦達代之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Minister of Rites Chen Dehua was dismissed for illness; Dong Bangda was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Chen Dehua left Rites ill and Dong Bangda took his place.

sentences.zh: 以楊廷璋為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Yang Tingzhang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Tingzhang became Works minister.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月戊申，以皇太后四巡江、浙，免江蘇、安徽、浙江歷年因災未完丁漕。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, spring, first month, day wushen: because the Empress Dowager was making her fourth tour of Jiangnan and Zhejiang, unpaid corvée and grain transport from past disasters in Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In spring's first month on wushen, Jiangsu, Anhui, and Zhejiang disaster arrears in corvée and transport were remitted for the Empress Dowager's fourth southern tour.

sentences.zh: 賑甘肅皋蘭等二十九廳州縣旱災、湖北監利等四縣水災有差。

translations.literal: Drought disaster in twenty-nine Gansu subprefectures, prefectures, and counties including Gaolan and flood disaster in four Hubei counties including Jianli were relieved at graded rates.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-nine Gansu units and four Hubei counties including Jianli received graded drought and flood relief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，劉綸丁憂，命莊有恭以刑部尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Liu Lun entered mourning; Zhuang Yougong was ordered as Minister of Punishments to serve as Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Liu Lun mourned and Zhuang Yougong joined the Grand Secretariat as Punishments minister.

sentences.zh: 以於敏中為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Yu Minzhong was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong became Revenue minister.

sentences.zh: 調明德為江蘇巡撫，和其衷為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Mingde was transferred to be Jiangsu governor; He Qizhong to Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Mingde took Jiangsu and He Qizhong Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 以彰寶為山西巡撫，文綬護之。

translations.literal: Zhang Bao was made Shanxi governor; Wen Shouhu acted for him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bao became Shanxi governor with Wen Shouhu acting.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上奉皇太后啟蹕南巡。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager as the imperial procession set out on the southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager began the southern tour.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，免直隸、山東經過州縣額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day guihai, three-tenths of quota taxes were remitted for prefectures and counties passed through in Zhili and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Zhili and Shandong counties on the route were given a three-tenths tax cut.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，上奉皇太后渡河。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuzi: the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager in crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on wuzi, the Emperor and Empress Dowager crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 閱清口東壩木龍、惠濟閘。

translations.literal: He inspected the wooden flood-dragons at the east embankment of Qingkou and the Huiji Sluice.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected Qingkou's east-embankment flood-dragons and the Huiji Sluice.

sentences.zh: 命阿桂赴伊犁辦事。

translations.literal: Agui was ordered to proceed to Ili for duty.
translations.idiomatic: Agui was sent to Ili on duty.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免江蘇州縣乾隆二十八年以前熟田地丁雜款舊欠，並經過州縣本年額賦之半。

translations.literal: On day renchen, old arrears in field-and-corvée and miscellaneous levies on mature land in Jiangsu prefectures and counties before Qianlong year 28 were remitted, and half this year's quota taxes for prefectures and counties passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Jiangsu tax arrears before year 28 were cleared and transit counties got half this year's quota.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上奉皇太后渡江。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager in crossing the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the court crossed the Yangzi with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 己亥，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 閏二月丙午朔，上奉皇太后臨幸蘇州府。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, first day bingwu: the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on a visit to Suzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary second month's bingwu new moon, the court visited Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 上謁文廟。

translations.literal: The Emperor paid homage at the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor visited the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免江甯、蘇州、杭州附郭諸縣本年丁銀。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, this year's corvée silver was remitted for suburban counties of Jiangning, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, corvée silver was remitted for counties around Jiangning, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 免浙江經過州縣本年額賦之半。

translations.literal: Half this year's quota taxes were remitted for Zhejiang prefectures and counties passed through.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang counties on the route got half this year's quota remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，醜達改葉爾羌辦事。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Chouda was transferred to duty at Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Chouda was sent to Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 命索琳赴庫倫辦事。

translations.literal: Suolin was ordered to proceed to Khüree for duty.
translations.idiomatic: Suolin was sent to Khüree.

sentences.zh: 以額爾景額為喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Erjing'e was made councillor at Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: Erjing'e became Kashgar councillor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上奉皇太后臨幸杭州府。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on a visit to Hangzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the court visited Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，烏什回人作亂，戕辦事大臣素誠。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Muslims of Ush rebelled and killed the duty officer Sucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Ush rebels killed the commissioner Sucheng.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，加沈德潛、錢陳群太子太傅。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Shen Deqian and Qian Chenqun were advanced to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Shen Deqian and Qian Chenqun became Grand Tutors.

sentences.zh: 命明瑞進剿烏什。

translations.literal: Mingrui was ordered to advance and suppress Ush.
translations.idiomatic: Mingrui was sent to crush the Ush rebellion.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命明瑞、額爾景額總理烏什軍務，明瑞節制各軍。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Mingrui and Erjing'e were ordered to take general charge of military affairs at Ush; Mingrui was to command all forces.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Mingrui and Erjing'e directed Ush operations with Mingrui commanding all troops.

sentences.zh: 命阿桂、明亮赴伊犁辦事。

translations.literal: Agui and Mingliang were ordered to proceed to Ili for duty.
translations.idiomatic: Agui and Mingliang were sent to Ili.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，舒赫德留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Shuhede remained at the capital on duty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Shuhede stayed in Beijing on duty.

sentences.zh: 以讬恩多署工部尚書。

translations.literal: Tuoenduo was ordered to act as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoenduo acted as Works minister.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，調明山為江西巡撫，王檢為廣東巡撫，李侍堯兼署。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Mingshan was transferred to be Jiangxi governor; Wang Jian to Guangdong governor; Li Shiyao to act concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Mingshan took Jiangxi, Wang Jian Guangdong, and Li Shiyao acted for him.

sentences.zh: 以李因培為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Yinpei was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yinpei became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜伊犁新築駐防城名曰惠遠，哈什回城曰懷順。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the newly walled garrison city at Ili was granted the name Huiyuan; the Muslim quarter at Kash was named Huaishun.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Ili's new garrison was named Huiyuan and Kash's Muslim quarter Huaishun.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免江蘇上元等五縣上年水旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yihai, last year's flood-and-drought quota taxes were remitted for five Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, five Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan were excused last year's disaster taxes.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子朔，賑湖北漢陽等七州縣上年水災。

translations.literal: Third month, first day bingzi: last year's flood disaster in seven Hubei prefectures and counties including Hanyang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on bingzi new moon, seven Hubei units including Hanyang received last year's flood relief.

sentences.zh: 上幸焦山。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited Jiaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor visited Jiaoshan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上奉皇太后駐江甯府。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager in halting at Jiangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the court halted at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上詣明太祖陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor went to the tomb of Ming Taizu and offered libation.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor poured libation at Ming Taizu's tomb.

sentences.zh: 幸尹繼善署。

translations.literal: He visited Yin Jishan's official residence.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Yin Jishan's yamen.

sentences.zh: 觀音保剿烏什逆回失利。

translations.literal: Guanyinbao suffered defeat in suppressing the rebellious Muslims of Ush.
translations.idiomatic: Guanyinbao was beaten back in the Ush campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以馮鈐為湖南巡撫，宋邦綏為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Feng Ling was made Hunan governor; Song Bangsui Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Feng Ling took Hunan and Song Bangsui Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上奉皇太后渡江。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager in crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the court crossed the river with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，果郡王弘適卒。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Prince Guo Hongshi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Prince Guo Hongshi died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以京察予大學士傅恆等敘。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Grand Secretary Fu Heng and others were graded in the metropolitan personnel review.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Fu Heng and other grand secretaries received capital review grades.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上閱高家堰堤，奉皇太后渡河。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor inspected the dyke at Gaojiayan and accompanied the Empress Dowager in crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, he inspected Gaojiayan's dyke and crossed the river with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 召尹繼善入閣辦事。

translations.literal: Yin Jishan was summoned to enter the Grand Council and serve on duty.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Jishan joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 以高晉為兩江總督。

translations.literal: Gao Jin was made governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jin became Two-Jiangs governor-general.

sentences.zh: 調李宏為江南河道總督，以李清時為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Li Hong was transferred to be director-general of the Jiangnan waterways; Li Qingshi was made director-general of the Hedong waterways.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hong took Jiangnan rivers and Li Qingshi Hedong rivers.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，追論素誠貪淫激變罪，籍產，戍其子于伊犁。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Sucheng was posthumously condemned for greed and debauchery that provoked mutiny; his property was confiscated and his son banished to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Sucheng was posthumously punished for corruption that sparked revolt; his estate was seized and his son sent to Ili.

sentences.zh: 以納世通、卡塔海諱匿敗狀，籍產治罪。

translations.literal: Nashitong and Katahai were punished with confiscation for concealing defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Nashitong and Katahai lost their estates for hiding defeats.

sentences.zh: 命永貴赴喀什噶爾辦事。

translations.literal: Yonggui was ordered to proceed to Kashgar for duty.
translations.idiomatic: Yonggui was sent to Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 以讬恩多署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Tuoenduo was ordered to act as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoenduo acted as Rites minister.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上渡河。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午朔，賑甘肅河州等三十六廳州縣上年雹水旱霜災。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day bingwu: last year's hail, flood, drought, and frost disasters in thirty-six Gansu subprefectures, prefectures, and counties including Hezhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingwu new moon, thirty-six Gansu units including Hezhou received last year's disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，免湖北漢陽等十二州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, last year's flood quota taxes were remitted for twelve Hubei prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, twelve Hubei units including Hanyang were excused last year's flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，追予故刑部尚書王士禎諡文簡。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the posthumous title Wenjian was granted to the late Minister of Punishments Wang Shizhen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Wang Shizhen received the posthumous name Wenjian.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上奉皇太后駐德州。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager in halting at Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the court halted at Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，裁江蘇淮徐海道。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Huai-Xu-Hai circuit of Jiangsu was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Jiangsu's Huai-Xu-Hai circuit was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上迓皇太后居申昜春園。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor went to receive the Empress Dowager as she took up residence at Changchun Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Emperor welcomed the Empress Dowager to Changchun Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛未，哈薩克使臣鄂托爾濟等入覲。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Kazakh envoys including Otorji came to court for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Kazakh envoys led by Otorji were received at court.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，晉封喀爾喀郡王羅布藏多爾濟為親王。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yihai: Khalkha Prince Robzang Dorji was promoted to prince of the first degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Robzang Dorji of the Khalkha was raised to a first-rank prince.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上臨果郡王弘適殯所，及簡勤親王奇通阿園寢賜奠。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor went in person to Prince Guo's mourning hall for Hongshi and bestowed offerings at Prince Jianqin's garden tomb for Qitong'a.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Emperor mourned at Prince Guo's hall for Hongshi and offered at Prince Jianqin's tomb for Qitong'a.

sentences.zh: 以和闐辦事大臣和誠婪索回人，奪職逮問。

translations.literal: Because Khotan Resident Minister He Cheng had extorted the Muslims, his office was removed and he was arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: He Cheng was dismissed and arrested for extorting Muslims while resident minister at Khotan.

sentences.zh: 命伊勒圖赴塔爾巴哈台辦事。

translations.literal: Yiletu was ordered to proceed to Tarbagatai to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yiletu was sent to handle affairs at Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，京師地震。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, an earthquake struck the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免安徽懷寧等十九州縣衛上年水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, quota land taxes were remitted for nineteen prefectures, counties, and guards of Anhui including Huaining for last year's flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, last year's flood taxes were remitted in nineteen Anhui districts including Huaining.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，納世通、卡塔海貽誤軍務，正法。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Nashitong and Katahai were executed according to law for mishandling military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Nashitong and Katahai were executed for military negligence.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，以楊廷璋署兩廣總督，明山暫署，董邦達署工部尚書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: Yang Tingzhang was made acting governor-general of Liangguang; Mingshan acted temporarily in office; Dong Bangda acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Yang Tingzhang became acting Liangguang governor-general, Mingshan acted in office, and Dong Bangda acting Works minister.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，晉封令貴妃魏氏為皇貴妃。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Noble Consort Wei of the Ling rank was promoted to Imperial Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Noble Consort Wei was raised to Imperial Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 己巳，諭明瑞勿受烏什逆回降。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Ming Rui was instructed not to accept the surrender of rebellious Muslims of Ushi.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Ming Rui was told to refuse Ushi rebel submissions.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，上奉皇太后秋獮木蘭。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinsi: the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt to Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the court hunted at Mulan with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以官保為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Guanbao was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Guanbao became Left Censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙未，前和闐辦事大臣和誠以貪婪鞫實，正法。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, former Khotan Resident Minister He Cheng was executed according to law after greed was proved at trial.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, He Cheng was executed once Khotan graft charges were proved.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，奪喀爾喀親王桑齋多爾濟爵。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the rank of Khalkha Prince Sangzhai Dorji was revoked.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Sangzhai Dorji of the Khalkha lost his princely rank.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰朔，減朝審、秋審緩決三次以上刑。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day jiachen: sentences deferred three or more times in court review and autumn review were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth-month new moon, thrice-deferred court and autumn sentences were reduced.

sentences.zh: 己未，上幸木蘭行圍。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor went to Mulan for the hunting encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor hunted at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賑甘肅靖遠等十一廳縣旱災。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, drought disaster in eleven department districts and counties of Gansu including Jingyuan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, drought relief reached eleven Gansu districts including Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，甘肅寧遠等州縣地震，命賑恤，並免本年額賦。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, earthquake in prefectures and counties of Gansu including Ningyuan; relief was ordered and this year's quota land taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Gansu earthquake districts including Ningyuan were relieved and this year's taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，賑山東章丘等二十一州縣水災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingzi: flood disaster in twenty-one prefectures and counties of Shandong including Zhangqiu was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Shandong floods in twenty-one districts including Zhangqiu were relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命尹繼善管兵部，劉統勳管刑部。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Yin Jishan was put in charge of the Ministry of War and Liu Tongxun the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Yin Jishan took the War Ministry and Liu Tongxun the Justice Ministry.

sentences.zh: 烏什叛回以城降。

translations.literal: Rebellious Muslims of Ushi surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Ushi rebels handed over the city.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以高恆為總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Gao Heng was made Superintendent of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Gao Heng became superintendent of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以明瑞等未將烏什叛人殄誅，送往伊犁，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, because Ming Rui and others had not exterminated the rebels of Ushi but sent them to Ili, the matter was referred to the ministry for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Ming Rui and others were severely censured for sending Ushi rebels to Ili instead of killing them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以李侍堯署工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Li Shiyao was made acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Li Shiyao became acting Works minister.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，明瑞、阿桂以辦烏什事務錯繆，褫職留任。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiyou: Ming Rui and Agui were stripped of office for errors in handling Ushi affairs but kept at their posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Ming Rui and Agui lost rank over Ushi mistakes but stayed on duty.

sentences.zh: 賑長蘆屬滄州等三場水災。

translations.literal: Flood disaster at three Changlu saltern fields subordinate to Cangzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Three Cangzhou salterns under Changlu received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，楊應琚陛見。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Yang Yingju had an audience at court.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Yang Yingju was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 命和其衷署陝甘總督，湯聘署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: He Qizhong was ordered acting governor-general of Shaan-Gan; Tang Pin acting governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He Qizhong became acting Shaan-Gan governor-general and Tang Pin acting Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，免江蘇海州等六州縣本年旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiyou: quota land taxes were remitted for six prefectures and counties of Jiangsu including Haizhou for this year's drought disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, this year's drought taxes were remitted in six Jiangsu districts including Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以吏部尚書傅森年老，授內大臣，調讬恩多代之。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because Minister of Personnel Fusen was old, he was appointed inner grand minister and Tuoenduo was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Fusen became an inner grand minister and Tuoenduo replaced him at Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以讬庸為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Tuoyong was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoyong became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 調馮鈐為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Feng Qian was transferred to be Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Qian was sent to Anhui as governor.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，醜達以扶同桑齋多爾濟私與俄羅斯貿易，正法。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Chouda was executed according to law for abetting Sangzhai Dorji in private trade with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Chouda was executed for helping Sangzhai Dorji trade secretly with Russia.

sentences.zh: 明瑞等以盡誅烏什附逆回眾奏聞。

translations.literal: Ming Rui and others memorialized that all Ushi rebel adherents had been put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui reported that every Ushi rebel follower had been killed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賑山東章丘等十八州縣水災，甘肅狄道等十二州縣雹霜災。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, flood in eighteen Shandong prefectures and counties including Zhangqiu and hail and frost disaster in twelve Gansu prefectures and counties including Didao were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Shandong floods and Gansu hail and frost damage were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以阿桂為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣，代安泰回京。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Agui was made Tarbagatai assistant pacification commissioner, replacing Antai who returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Agui went to Tarbagatai and Antai returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，解阿桂工部尚書，以蘊著代之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Agui was released from the Ministry of Works and Yunzhu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Agui left Works and Yunzhu took his place.

sentences.zh: 以嵩椿為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Songchun was made general at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Songchun became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賑甘肅靖遠等十一廳縣旱災，並免額賦。

translations.literal: On day wushen, drought in eleven Gansu department districts and counties including Jingyuan was relieved and quota taxes remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Gansu drought districts including Jingyuan were fed and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賑山東齊河等十五州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yimao, flood in fifteen Shandong prefectures and counties including Qihe was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, fifteen Shandong flood counties including Qihe were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命讬恩多兼署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Tuoenduo was ordered additionally to act as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Tuoenduo was told also to act as War minister.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，封皇五子永祺為榮親王。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the fifth imperial son Yong Qi was enfeoffed as Prince Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the fifth son Yong Qi became Prince Rong.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，以陝西涇陽縣貢生張璘七世同居，賜御製詩章、緞匹。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu: because tribute licentiate Zhang Lin of Jingyang county, Shaanxi, had seven generations living together, imperially composed poems and bolts of satin were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zhang Lin of Jingyang was rewarded with imperial poems and satin for seven generations under one roof.
